notes.title: 🛡️ A Note from the Shields of Loyalty Team
notes.notes:
[p]⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/111fc006d4d8a26227a98a4617ae0b599add6c02.png"][/img]   [/p][hr][/hr][h2]🛡️ A Note from the Shields of Loyalty Team[/h2][p]Dear players,[/p][p]We want to take a moment to speak openly and honestly with you.[/p][p]We are a [b]true indie team[/b] of just 6–7 people. Most of us have children, and full-time jobs outside of this project. Shields of Loyalty has been our passion project for years, built in the late evenings, weekends, and stolen moments of free time. Getting here was not easy — but with your support, we’ve managed to make it happen.[/p][p]Yes, we know the game is not perfect. Many of the issues you’ve reported were already on our radar, but the last stretch before release meant balancing dozens of fixes, updates, and content additions. It was tough on us too.[/p][p]But please know this: [b]we are listening, and we are fixing things as you read these words.[/b][/p][p]Even some of the biggest AAA studios, with hundreds of developers and millions in budget, had rocky launches — but thanks to patient, loyal communities, they turned things around. (Think of [i]No Man’s Sky[/i], [i]Cyberpunk 2077[/i], or [i]Final Fantasy XIV[/i] — each went from struggle to success because of dedicated fans who believed in them.)[/p][p]We don’t have their resources. What we do have is [b]you[/b] — the players who believe in our vision and see what Shields of Loyalty can become. If you can give us a little patience as we patch, polish, and heal after this intense journey, we promise we’ll keep delivering improvements.[/p][p]This game was made by gamers, for gamers.
And with your help, it will only get better.[/p][p]Thank you for walking this path with us.
[/p][p]📝 [b]Your bug reports are incredibly valuable to us.[/b][/p][p]Every detail you share helps us track down issues faster and make Shields of Loyalty stronger. You can submit your reports in our Steam Discussions, on our [url="https://discord.gg/6ZXjBQZq"]Discord Bug Report section[/url], or directly by email at [/p][p][url="https://support@mosaicmask-studio.com"]support@mosaicmask-studio.com[/url][/p][p]. Thank you for helping us improve the game together![/p][p]

— The Shields of Loyalty Team 🛡️
  ⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/eb9bdd7501f1c6c68195a45bf8cda19dec88c02e.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: LORE SNIPPET: 🔥 Karnoth, the Bull of the Barren Wrath
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/f7cc0a686c94cb5cd323a4f3185ce0b66b61e14e.png"][/img]🔥 Karnoth, the Bull of the Barren Wrath[/p][p][b]Avatar of the Warlord Faction[/b][/p][quote][p][i]“Steel may bend, but fury never breaks.”[/i] — Karnoth[/p][/quote][p]In the scarred and sun-cracked lands now called the [b]Barren Wrath[/b], there was once a fertile valley where warriors of old trained endlessly in the art of war. That valley became a grave of empires when a forgotten catastrophe — a ritual of blood and conquest gone wrong — shattered the skies and scorched the earth.[/p][p]From this devastation rose [b]Karnoth[/b], the first and last of his kind.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/8d11eefad1ead17ddb12042662a2f05cc1055aed.png"][/img]Forged not born, Karnoth was shaped by a godless war-prayer echoing through the bones of the land. He emerged from a fusion of beast and fury, summoned by the dying breath of the Warlord who had led the doomed ritual. His form was that of a towering bull-man: horned, monstrous, and divine in his wrath. His sword was carved from the molten spine of the last mountain god, and his shield still bears the mark of his progenitor's blood-seal.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/549cd0d6078b8081239d9ed8a1f9ca4c7154c757.png"][/img]Though Karnoth was born of failure, he became the Warlord Faction's symbol of defiance — a living siege engine, a force of primal strength and unyielding command. His lair remains the [b]lower canyon of the Barren Wrath[/b], a cracked land where nothing grows, but where war still echoes.[/p][p]Now, Karnoth leads the Warlords not just as a commander, but as their [b]Avatar[/b] — the embodiment of unbroken dominance. The fortress that towers over the broken valley was raised under his command, each building a symbol of survival through might. Under Karnoth’s banner, legions of infantry march with brutal discipline, for he teaches that tactics mean nothing if not backed by raw force.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/8e0862fa08272c0a11957aceeb03ec28444e1d18.png"][/img][/p][p]His arrival on the battlefield shifts the very ground, crashing into enemy lines with unstoppable mass. When he charges, mountains remember their scars.[/p][p]He is not worshipped. He is obeyed.

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/eb9bdd7501f1c6c68195a45bf8cda19dec88c02e.png"][/img]
[b][i]Note: All images were created using the Canva AI image generator.
At the moment, our talented graphic designers are fully focused on the game itself — so hand-drawn illustrations for fan-fiction content aren't possible just yet.[/i][/b][/p][p][b][i]I hope you’ll forgive this small workaround, as I simply wanted to bring you some exciting lore to explore![/i][/b][/p][p][b][i]Thanks for your understanding and continued support.
Yours truly,
Çağdaş “Charlie” Özhan
Community Manager[/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: 📅 Tactical Tuesday – Terrain is Tactics
notes.notes:
[p]⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/111fc006d4d8a26227a98a4617ae0b599add6c02.png"][/img][/p][h3][/h3][h3]📅 [b]Tactical Tuesday – Terrain is Tactics[/b][/h3][p]In [i]Shields of Loyalty[/i], brute force alone doesn’t win wars. Knowing the battlefield — and how to use it — is just as vital as your unit composition.[/p][p]From ancient ruins to storm-ridden fields, every tile holds potential. A skilled tactician studies the land before making a move.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🔍 [b]Master the Battlefield:[/b][/p][p]🏰 [b]Structures = Cover & Consequence[/b]
Ruins, towns, and castles provide defensive bonuses. Beware though — siege units deal extra damage to enemies inside these fortified tiles.[/p][p]⚡ [b]Weather Isn’t Just Cosmetic[/b] Lightning strikes, fire, and ice rain change battlefield conditions. They can hinder movement, reduce visibility, or even damage units — plan ahead![/p][p]🧭 [b]Choke Points and Flanks[/b]
Use bridges and narrow valleys to control enemy movement. Place durable infantry to block — then send fast units around the side for devastating flanks.[/p][p]🧱 [b]Height = Advantage[/b]
Ranged units on elevated ground get an [b]increased attack range[/b]. High ground isn’t just cinematic — it’s tactical.[/p][p]🌲 [b]Terrain Affects Unit Types[/b]
• Cavalry thrives on [b]open plains[/b], allowing better mobility and charge effectiveness.
• Infantry performs better in [b]forests[/b], where movement is slower, but cover is greater.
• Different tiles affect different units — so explore, experiment, and adapt.

🛩️ [b]Flying Units Bypass Terrain[/b]
Ideal for surprise attacks and quick retreats, flying units are your best bet when the battlefield gets messy.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/0d9c80b51211733b36cb4dd0822952419f01974f.png"][/img][/p][p]📌 Tip: Hover over tiles during gameplay to learn about their effects. Mastery of the land could be your winning edge.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🛡️ [b]So, tactician... how do YOU use the terrain to dominate your foes?[/b]
Tell us your best battlefield manoeuvres and terrain tricks in the comments![/p][p]🎯 Don’t forget to wishlist [i]Shields of Loyalty[/i] – launching 12 August:

notes.title: 🎯 Nostalgia – Strategy Never Dies

notes.title: 🛡️ Tactical Tuesday – Light Cavalry's Formation Skill Explained 🐎
notes.notes:
[p]⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/111fc006d4d8a26227a98a4617ae0b599add6c02.png"][/img][/p][h3]🛡️ [b]Tactical Tuesday – Light Cavalry's Formation Skill Explained[/b] 🐎
[/h3][p][b][i]IMPORTANT NOTE: This post was scheduled for yesterday but it is postponed because of a setting in the post schedules. Sorry for the inconvenience. Now I will share this post with today's post together. Have fun blogging.[/i][/b]

Let’s take a closer look at one of the unique [b]passive abilities[/b] in [i]Shields of Loyalty[/i] — the [b]Formation[/b] skill of [b]Light Cavalry[/b] (Noblemen units).

🎥 [i]\[See GIF][/i]: In this short moment, the Light Cavalry is attacked — but instead of taking damage, it [b]falls back by one tile[/b] and [b]completely avoids the hit (damage does show but doesn't apply)[/b]. That’s the power of [b]Formation[/b].
[/p][h3]⠀⠀⠀⠀[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/959150763e9fb79f3afa105d7072e9b6438025ca.gif"][/img]__________________________________________________
[/h3][p]🔍 [i]\[See Screenshot][/i]: You’ll notice the [b]Formation Count[/b] displayed on the [b]unit info panel[/b] (top right of the screen). Each Light Cavalry has a limited number of these passive evasions per battle.
[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/ef065ee58a6fcb590097da0a401be4a3de08bfc1.png"][/img][/h3][h3]🧠 How it works:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Passive trigger[/b] – No need to activate manually.[/p][/*][*][p]When attacked and the Formation is available:
→ The unit [b]falls back 1 tile[/b]
→ [b]Receives no damage[/b][/p][/*][*][p]If the Formation can’t trigger (e.g. it’s used up, no space to retreat, or the unit is heavily damaged):
→ The unit [b]still falls back[/b] like any other,
→ But [b]takes the full damage[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p]💡 Use Light Cavalry wisely — they’re mobile, quick, and can slip out of danger... but not forever. Keep an eye on that Formation count!
[/p][p][b]— The Shields of Loyalty Team[/b]

[/p][p][/p][p]

notes.title: 🐐 LORE SNIPPET: “The Fall of the Goatking”

[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/d90eea30d961a3f5a78b77b18e38178fe73c4e40.png"][/img]Long ago, when Mantaria's forests still whispered with wild magic, the spirits of nature shaped a warrior-guardian to protect their realm. From twisted roots and ancient bones, they gave form to the [b]Goatking[/b] — a beast with the lower body of a goat and the upper body of a hulking warrior.[/p][p]He wielded a crude sword forged from ironwood and raw ore, his wooden shield carved from sacred groves. His twisted horns bore moss, and his white fur shimmered in moonlight. For a time, he was a protector. But with each century, solitude and power turned him cruel.[/p][p]He no longer guarded the forests — he ruled them.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/732e41c1360f1385296be0242bab801f3cbb98db.png"][/img]The Goatking’s wrath reached the walls of [b]Castle Rifthain[/b], where fire scorched the woods and storms howled without end. Creatures of the wild followed him, corrupted by his command. One by one, nearby villages vanished.[/p][p]But then came [b]Aglovan[/b], noble of the Crimson Order. With golden armour and a blade passed down through generations, he marched through the burning woods. By his side flew an eagle, watching from above.[/p][p]As he neared the gates of Rifthain, lightning cracked and the Goatking stepped forward — sword in hand, ready to crush Mantaria’s last hope.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/0e32b306b0f6d8cc597159381df6a0c510a3faab.png"][/img] The final clash was swift — steel against fury. Aglovan charged, his eagle screeching above. The Goatking roared and met him head-on, sword raised.[/p][p]Steel clashed. Sparks danced. The world seemed to hold its breath.[/p][p]Then, in a flash of blinding light, Aglovan’s blade found its mark. The Goatking staggered, eyes wide, and let out a final, thunderous cry. He fell to his knees before the castle he once cursed.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/5d488bc7f600e0fa92afd57ca11f739390fed850.png"][/img][/p][p]The skies cleared. The fires died.[/p][p]Mantaria had a new legend.

notes.title: 🧠 Tactical Tuesday – From Middle-earth to Mantaria
notes.notes:
[p]⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/111fc006d4d8a26227a98a4617ae0b599add6c02.png"][/img][/p][h3]🛡️ A Legacy of Strategy in Fantasy[/h3][p]From the page to the screen, epic fantasy has always revolved around the battlefield—whether it’s a desperate stand at Helm’s Deep, the coordination of a small fellowship striking behind enemy lines, or carefully arranged tactical decisions in turn-based classics like [i]Fantasy General[/i] or [i]XCOM[/i].[/p][p]At [i]Shields of Loyalty[/i], we honour those roots while forging something new.[/p][quote][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/09bdb37aeda68ec04565e3774dc1e65b5bfeb553.png"][/img][/p][/quote][hr][/hr][h3]🔄 Faction Abilities Reforged[/h3][p]We’ve reworked the [b]faction skills[/b] system to enhance synergy, positioning, and reaction-based tactics. Here’s a sneak peek:[/p][p]🔴 Warlords – Strength in Unity[/p][list][*][p][b]Brothers in Arms[/b]
If a heavy infantry unit attacks, another heavy infantry unit directly adjacent to it will strike as well—two blades, one purpose.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Revenge[/b]
When one of your units is severely wounded, all adjacent allies lash out in retaliation. The more surrounded you are, the stronger your comeback.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]⚪ Noblemen – Discipline and Formation[/p][list][*][p][b]Formation[/b]
Light cavalry now automatically steps back one tile after taking damage. This ability can trigger up to three times per level, simulating controlled retreats and regrouping.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shield Wall[/b]
Unchanged but still powerful: Hold your line and resist frontal assaults by keeping units adjacent and shielded.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]🔵 Highpriests – The Arcane Edge[/p][list][*][p][b]Mystic Focus[/b] [i](tentative name)[/i]
Boost magical damage dealt and reduce magic damage taken—a potent way to counter enemy spellcasters.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Guardian[/b]
A known mechanic returns under a new banner: nearby flying units intercept attacks aimed at adjacent allies.[/p][/*][/list][quote][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/3ad1c0e90672fb4c6267085b9792e85c72833865.png"][/img][/p][/quote][hr][/hr][h3]🎶 Tactical Music, Personalised by Faction[/h3][p]We’ve also added [b]faction-specific music[/b] to the [b]Army Management screen[/b]! Each faction now has its own distinct melody and tone to match its theme—noble, tribal, or mystical.[/p][quote][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/ce7d751ea6e18b5e02d2e4b4332c9cec8836a755.jpg"][/img][/p][/quote][hr][/hr][h3]🌍 What’s Next on the Tactical Front?[/h3][list][*][p][b]More Points of Interest (POIs)[/b] are live![/p][/*][*][p][b]Mercenaries[/b] are now recruitable.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Island 3 levels[/b] have been expanded with new tactical challenges.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Numerous level improvements and balance adjustments[/b] are in the works.[/p][/*][/list][quote][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/0ee88b42680e9dec9685a20c235b2b8cfc60e21c.jpg"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/8068307d2a2ad569e62104ae3eac8e9dd602d9e9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/fb62a042cfebb3f802f43dbf935b736d30e60144.png"][/img]
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/78e872751735af06c5b3fd9e9607db4f5d8dae29.gif"][/img]⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/60ff6da6433b3d4a52a03981579762225dd39be2.gif"][/img][/p][/quote][hr][/hr][h3]⚔️ Tactical Evolution Continues[/h3][p]At its heart, [i]Shields of Loyalty[/i] is about meaningful, satisfying choices.
Whether you’re flanking with cavalry, casting support spells, or defending your last stronghold—you’ll find inspiration in fantasy’s finest moments… and write your own legend in Mantaria.[/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates, Commanders![/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔁 Got a favourite tactic from a classic game or fantasy book?[/h3][p]Tell us in the comments—we might feature it in the next [b]Tactical Tuesday[/b]![/p][h3][/h3][p][b]— The Shields of Loyalty Team[/b]

[/p][p][/p][p]

notes.title: 🛡 Shields of Loyalty – 1.0 Release Highlights 🎉 Ideas, Focuses and WIP
notes.notes:
[p]
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/111fc006d4d8a26227a98a4617ae0b599add6c02.png"][/img]
[/p][h1]🛡 [i]Shields of Loyalty[/i] – 1.0 Release Highlights 🎉
[/h1][p][b]Prepare for the Ultimate Strategy Experience![/b]
Our team has worked relentlessly to bring you the best version of [i]Shields of Loyalty[/i]. Here's what's coming with the long-awaited 1.0 release – straight from our dev team's workspace:

[b][i]IMPORTANT NOTE: Some of these points in the list were derived from our visions, your feedbacks and the general strategy game knowledge of out team. Please note that the most important ones are WIP (Work-in-progress) but some may won't be finished or even not included in the final build. We are trying to deliver the game to you in the best condition possible but delivering it is the most important point that we are focusing on! Thanks a lot for your patience and support![/i][/b][/p][hr][/hr][h3]⚙️ PERFORMANCE & QUALITY OF LIFE BOOSTS[/h3][list][*][p][b]Massive Performance Improvements[/b] – Faster AI, smoother animations, and snappier gameplay across the board.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Simultaneous Combat Resolution[/b] – Damage effects, spell visuals, and support actions now play out in parallel for faster, smoother battles.[/p][/*][*][p][b]AI Turn Optimisation[/b] – AI decisions (movement, spells, and abilities) now execute with less delay and more efficiency.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Camera Movement Tweaks[/b] – Enhanced camera flow and zoom during battles.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Faster Spell Effects[/b] – Weather, lightning, and special abilities now trigger more quickly and cinematically.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Multi-unit Move System[/b] – Control up to 3 units simultaneously to speed up your army’s advance![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]⚔️ COMBAT & STRATEGY ENHANCEMENTS[/h3][list][*][p][b]Full AI Rework[/b] – Smarter decisions, better positioning, and strategic use of spells and abilities.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cinematic Spell Effects[/b] – Camera shakes, flashes, and new visual cues for healing, buffs, debuffs, and elemental magic.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Zone of Control (ZOC)[/b] – Adds tactical weight to unit positioning (coming post-launch if not ready at 1.0).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Movement Cost Display[/b] – Clearly see movement costs per tile to optimise your pathing.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Pathfinding[/b] – Navigate around enemies, fire, storms and blocked paths with ease.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stack-aware Combat Logic[/b] – AI avoids overcommitting to heavily protected or weak target units.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🗺️ CAMPAIGN & MAP CONTENT[/h3][list][*][p][b]Final Level Unlocked[/b] – Discover the climactic battle with epic terrain combining Darkwoods and Lava Desert tiles.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Maps Added[/b] – Several new battle maps included for campaign and custom games.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Special Victory Conditions Update[/b] – Victory only triggers when you end your turn after objectives are met, so you can loot freely![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🌌 FACTION AURAS & BALANCE[/h3][list][*][p][b]Void Faction Auras[/b] – Malphas, The Goat King, Succubus, Spider Queen, The Void (each with unique passive effects).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Knight Faction Auras[/b] – New aura abilities for Aglovan and other Knight heroes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Warlord & High Priest Auras[/b] – Unique faction-specific buffs to enhance tactical depth.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mummy’s Curse Reworked[/b] – Balance adjustments for this fearsome spell.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🧙‍♂️ SPELLS & MAGIC SYSTEM[/h3][list][*][p][b]Missing Spells Defined & Implemented[/b] – All T3 and faction spells are now complete and in-game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]AI Spellcasting Behaviour[/b] – Magic-wielding enemy units now behave strategically, using spells according to situation and trigger logic.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Spell Descriptions Finalised[/b] – Localisation and visual effects defined per spell type.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ USER INTERFACE & VISUAL POLISH[/h3][list][*][p][b]Updated Tutorial Texts[/b] – Reflecting the latest UI and gameplay changes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Upgrade Indicators for Units[/b] – Easily see which units are ready to be promoted.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Attack Animation Revamp[/b] – Clean, focused, with the death blow and death animation aligned visually.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New City/Castle/Ruin UI Graphics[/b] – Fresh designs for a more immersive experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hover Tooltips for Artefact Menu[/b] – Clearer indication when artefact management becomes available.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Critical Hit Banner[/b] – Now displayed clearly in combat like other special effects.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dual Unit Display[/b] – Toggle between airborne and ground units when occupying the same tile.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🏰 WORLDMAP, EVENTS & LOOT[/h3][list][*][p][b]Loot Buff[/b] – Cities and ruins now offer 1.5x increased rewards. More reason to explore![/p][/*][*][p][b]Mercenaries Added[/b] – Hire unique units in cities, tents, and mines. notes.title: Tactical Tuesday - Comeback Edition!
notes.notes:
[p]⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/111fc006d4d8a26227a98a4617ae0b599add6c02.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][/h2][h3][b]"In strategy, the longest path often leads to the greatest victory."[/b][/h3][h1]
We’re back — and with that, Tactical Tuesday returns![/h1][p]Today, let’s reflect on [i]why[/i] we love turn-based strategy games and dark fantasy so much — and how [b]Shields of Loyalty[/b] fits into this legacy.[/p][p][/p][h2][b] 🔍 A Brief Origin of Strategy Games[/b][/h2][p]
Turn-based strategy games trace their roots to classic tabletop wargames like [i]Tactics (1954)[/i] and [i]Kriegsspiel (1824)[/i], long before computers brought them to our screens.
Titles like [i]Fire Emblem[/i], [i]X-COM[/i], and [i]Fantasy General[/i] later shaped the genre into what we know and love today — [b]deliberate, challenging, and deeply tactical[/b].[/p][p][b]Shields of Loyalty[/b] follows in their footsteps, combining precise positioning, synergising unit types, and calculated risks across epic campaigns. If you're a fan of careful planning and heroic sacrifice — you’re in the right place.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]🌑 What Makes Dark Fantasy So Appealing? [/b][/h2][p]
Dark Fantasy pushes against the high-fantasy tropes of perfect heroes and clear good vs evil. In its place:
• [i]Morally grey choices[/i]
• [i]Tragic heroes[/i]
• [i]Corrupt gods, cursed lands, and grim victories[/i][/p][p][b]Shields of Loyalty[/b] embraces this tone fully, drawing inspiration from stories like [i]Berserk[/i], [i]Dark Souls[/i], and [i]The Witcher[/i]. Our world of Mantaria is no shining kingdom — it’s broken, twisted, and in need of a last stand.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]🔁 Tactical Features in Our Game [/b][/h2][p]
• Unit synergy combos (e.g. flying guardians & shield cavalry)
• Combat roles: front-line tanks, flanking scouts, and support casters
• Terrain impact and weather effects (ice storms, lightning, etc.)
• Heavy siege units, stealth skirmishers, and flying units
• Future mechanics: [b]Zone of Control & Attack of Opportunity[/b] coming soon![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/866cb87c0053343919d6347d6b51c55731a4b516.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]🎯 Question for the Community: [/b][/h2][p]
What’s [b]your[/b] favourite tactical mechanic in turn-based games?
Or: What made you fall in love with dark fantasy settings?[/p][p]Let’s talk tactics — and get hyped again.

notes.title: Devblog 40 – Divine Minds: Archmages of the High Priest
notes.notes:
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/333549967681e2933af61dd9b70abd7beba36fab.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/111fc006d4d8a26227a98a4617ae0b599add6c02.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Devblog 40 – Divine Minds: Archmages of the High Priest[/h1]

[b]Sneak peek into the arcane forces of faith![/b]

Welcome back, Commanders of Mantaria!

As we move closer and closer to the release of [i]Shields of Loyalty[/i], we continue to reveal the powerful units at your command. In this week’s devblog, we unveil the [b]Archmage class[/b] of the High Priest faction—a set of unique casters wielding devastating magical abilities in the name of divine order.

[h2]🧙 High Priest Archmages – Tier 1, 2, and 3 Units[/h2]

These powerful sorcerers channel faith into magic, shaping the battlefield with radiant spells, holy wrath, and protective enchantments.

[b]🔹 Tier 1: Sanctifier[/b]
A humble priest-turned-warrior, capable of healing nearby allies and weakening enemies through divine presence. Low offence, high utility.

[b]🔮 Tier 2: Oracle of Purity[/b]
This unit brings mid-range offensive magic and area control. Expect status afflictions like silence, fear, or even paralysis—delivered with holy might.

[b]🌩️ Tier 3: Archmage of Revelation[/b]
The ultimate caster of the High Priest faction. Wielding chain-lightning, mass healing, and holy bombardment spells, this unit changes the tide of battle.
An awe-inspiring presence… and a priority target for any enemy commander.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/572c64dce496b13f65f51a7c3685069a65e34497.png[/img]

[h2]🧠 Magic Meets Machinery – What Does It All Mean?[/h2]

With last week’s [b]Siege Engines[/b] and the [b]Mercenary Musketeer[/b] bringing technology into the fold, and now the holy [b]Archmages[/b] joining the battlefield, the strategic depth of [i]Shields of Loyalty[/i] continues to grow.

These elements together shape a battlefield where [b]faith, fire, and foresight[/b] collide.

Magic isn’t just flashy—it’s a [b]tactical layer[/b]. Who you bring and how you use them will make all the difference.

[h2]🗺️ Lore Pieces – Coming Very Soon[/h2]

We’ve heard you—[b]you miss the lore pieces[/b].
We’re happy to announce that the continuation of [b]Aglovan’s journey[/b] through the Third Island is almost ready. Expect new chapters very soon!

Let us know:
[b]Do you enjoy reading them? Want them voiced later? Or turned into cutscenes?[/b] We’re listening.

[h2]📣 Countdown to Release[/h2]

Everything is moving forward as planned. We're close.
Your support, shares, and wishlists [b]help more than you know[/b]. Indie development at this stage is about trust—between developer and player.

[b]Together, we're bringing back a feeling.[/b]
Something we remember from [i]Fantasy General[/i], from [i]Heroes of Might and Magic[/i], from the golden age of dark fantasy TBS games.

We want this to live again—and you’re a part of it.

[h2]📜 Last Week’s Devblog & Patch Notes[/h2]

Did you miss [b]Devblog 39[/b]?
It showcased the terrifying siege units of the High Priest faction: Blade Engine, Fire Engine, and the divine Cannon of Revelation. Catch up here:
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1318240/view/543354486002811431

Also, more [b]patch notes are coming soon[/b], so keep an eye out. Our developer is hard at work and will post updates as they arrive!

notes.title: Devblog 39 – Engines of Faith and Fire
notes.notes:
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/333549967681e2933af61dd9b70abd7beba36fab.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/111fc006d4d8a26227a98a4617ae0b599add6c02.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Devblog 39 – Engines of Faith and Fire[/h1]

[b]The High Priest Faction rolls into battle with sacred siege power![/b]
Welcome back, Commanders!

We're thrilled to share another exciting batch of content as we move closer and closer to the official release of [i]Shields of Loyalty[/i]. This week, we’re taking a look at the [b]Siege Units of the High Priest faction[/b], revisiting an old mercenary ally, and opening a discussion about the spirit behind our game.

[h2]⚙️ High Priest Siege Engines – Tier 1, 2, and 3 Units[/h2]

These divine machines were forged with holy wrath and engineered precision. Each tier brings you closer to total divine dominance on the battlefield:

[b]🪓 Tier 1: Blade Engine[/b]
A sacred mechanical contraption that slashes through defences with spinning blessed blades. Fast, efficient, and terrifying.

[b]🔥 Tier 2: Fire Engine[/b]
Fuelled by divine incantations and hellfire, this engine rains burning punishment onto enemy walls and units.

[b]💥 Tier 3: Cannon of Revelation[/b]
This is the High Priest's answer to worldly technology—combining holiness and gunpowder to shatter any defence. Walls tremble. So do armies.

[h2]💂 Mercenary Reminder – Musketeer[/h2]

Let’s not forget our old friend, the [b]Mercenary Musketeer[/b].
One of the first gunpowder-based units introduced in the game, this sharpshooter adds a whole new flavour to Mantaria's otherwise medieval tone.

With the addition of these High Priest siege engines, [b]gunpowder is no longer a luxury—it’s part of the future[/b]. How will it affect balance? Strategy? Lore? Let us know what you think!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/10c4b1af262cad6fcaaf2aa42f394802e8b4f53e.png[/img]

[h2]🧠 Let’s Talk – Why We’re Making This Game[/h2]

We know TBS fans are patient, thoughtful players. But you’ve waited long, and we thank you deeply.

[b]Turn-Based Strategy[/b] isn’t just gameplay—it’s a feeling. Planning. Positioning. Tension.
[b]Dark Fantasy[/b] adds stakes. Adds grit. Adds mystery.

Games like [i]Fantasy General[/i], [i]X-COM[/i], [i]Heroes of Might and Magic[/i]—they meant something. We want [i]Shields of Loyalty[/i] to echo those legendary feelings.
That’s why we keep going. That’s why we polish every detail.

[b]And we’re almost there.[/b]

Stick with us. Bear the wait a little longer—and witness a rebirth of that heroic dark fantasy TBS spirit.

[h2]📜 Lore Pieces – Aglovan’s Journey Will Continue[/h2]

Yes, it’s coming!
Many of you have asked when the next [b]Lore Pieces[/b] will drop—and we’re happy to say: [b]Soon.[/b]

We’re preparing the final island's lore entries now. [b]Aglovan’s tale is far from over.[/b]
Tell us—do you enjoy this lore format? Would you prefer more detailed or interactive elements in the future?

Let’s shape this story together.

[h2]📢 Final Notes & Community Shoutout[/h2]

Thanks again for your overwhelming support on last week’s devblog.
If you missed it, [b]Devblog 38[/b] introduced the High Priest Bombardier class and a new Mercenary: [i]Dark Soul[/i].

As always, your [b]wishlist, shares, and feedback[/b] are what fuel this project.
[b]Our developer will continue posting patch notes as they arrive—stay tuned![/b]

Until next time, Commander.
[b]Stay Loyal.[/b]

The Shields of Loyalty Team

notes.notes:
[h1]Devblog 38 – The High Priests' Bombardiers & a Dark New Mercenary[/h1]

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/333549967681e2933af61dd9b70abd7beba36fab.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/111fc006d4d8a26227a98a4617ae0b599add6c02.png[/img][/url]


Commanders, the battlefield is evolving! The [b]3rd faction—The High Priests—introduces their Bombardier class[/b], a devastating force specializing in ranged explosive attacks. These powerful units will bring destruction from afar with [b]four different tiers[/b], each more deadly than the last!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/2c5dbbd9f9b8404c045a9a2b35a8b5f8c33dcba3.png[/img]

[h2]🔥 New Unique Bombardier Units (3rd Faction – High Priests):[/h2]
✅ [b]Tier 1:[/b] Initiate Bombardier – Basic ranged explosive specialist
✅ [b]Tier 2:[/b] Flame Bringer – Spreading fire and destruction
✅ [b]Tier 3:[/b] Thunder Prophet – Wielding storm-infused bombardments
✅ [b]Tier 4:[/b] Wrath of the Heavens – Unmatched devastation on the battlefield

[h3]Patch Notes – Update 0.9.0.42[/h3]

Our dedicated development team has been hard at work addressing critical issues and enhancing gameplay on [b]our internal test branch and these will be available for Steam soon[/b]. Here’s a comprehensive list of the latest fixes:

[b]Gameplay Fixes:[/b]

[*] Resolved an issue where clicking an exclamation mark during attack animations caused the game to freeze.
[*] Fixed a bug where casting spells on large units would cause the game to become unresponsive.
[*] Addressed duplication of boss units and their inability to attack.
[*] Improved AI pathfinding and turn logic for more strategic enemy movements.
[*] Corrected an issue preventing progression after research completion without restarting the game.
[/list]

[b]Localization and Text Corrections:[/b]
[list]
[*] Ensured defense values do not exceed 100%.
[*] Adjusted auras of avatars for consistency.
[*] Fixed various typographical errors in unit names, dialogues, and tooltips.

[b]Visual and Audio Enhancements:[/b]
[list]

[*] Improved spell effects for a more immersive visual experience.
[*] Resolved missing textures on the "Treasure Hunt" map.
[*] Corrected unit icon issues, including the Valkyrie unit icon in the Valkyrie Aerie.
[*] Fixed animation errors for Dryad and Sylph attacks.
[*] Adjusted new sound effects that were previously too quiet.
[*] Ensured music transitions smoothly between menus.
[/list]

[b]User Interface Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Units with no available actions are now greyed out, and the end turn confirmation dialogue is skipped if no unit has actions left.
[*] Updated the artifact menu to display units correctly.
[*] Fixed overlapping text issues, such as the "Force of Nature" text overlapping the UI.
[*] Corrected graphical glitches when zooming in and out on certain maps.
[*] Ensured equipped items display correctly during missions.
[*] Resolved issues with construction and tier upgrades.
[*] Improved display of aura buffs and artifact-loaded units' stats.
[/list]

[b][i]Our beta testers have been instrumental in identifying and reporting these issues. Their dedication is immensely appreciated, and we continue to welcome new testers to join our bug hunt. If you're passionate about improving Shields of Loyalty, consider applying to be a beta tester through our Discord server.[/i][/b]

Your trust and patience are invaluable to us, and we believe that, together, we can achieve greatness.

notes.title: Lore Piece #16: The Tower
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/23b3e9ed0f4d7f8d82d6706413e6a28465d68a26.png[/img]

The frozen winds howled around us as we approached the looming tower of Alaris, the legendary magician of Eternal Ice Island. Yet, we were not the only ones drawn to this place. A sea of Undead surged ahead, their rotting forms twisting in unnatural movement, their hollow eyes fixed upon the structure like moths to a flame.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/7838ca9805084502883432e9c2130df8c8606556.png[/img]
From which hells had these monstrosities risen, and what terrible knowledge had led them here? The sheer number of them suggested that Alaris, or something within his tower, was of immense importance. But a far darker thought chilled us deeper than the frigid air—had the Undead already turned the magician into one of their own?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/b538a69db1a53c3617d09cd730b56feb2731b96a.png[/img]
Steel clashed against bone, and magic burned through cursed flesh as we fought our way to the entrance. The battle was relentless, the Undead seemingly unyielding. Yet, as the final abomination fell, silence claimed the tower once more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/91b4b5e97c0794dcedfa7b01c6a8f2caf7988d2d.png[/img]
Inside, devastation awaited us. The grand library, once a bastion of knowledge, had been ransacked, scrolls and tomes scattered across the cold stone floor. It was clear that someone—or something—had been searching for something specific. Amid the wreckage, one parchment stood out. It bore a single, enigmatic sentence:

"The Stone of Life is the key!"

Was this Alaris’ discovery? A means to end the Undead blight? Or was it a desperate clue left behind as he was taken? And then there was the portal in the basement—was it his doing, or had he been forced through it?

The answers lay beyond. We could not turn back now.

notes.title: Lore Piece #15.2: The Amulet
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/9792d39818744c327c6037f28a8f81822feb990b.png[/img]

[b]The Lost Fragments of Power[/b]

The priest’s cryptic words still echoed in Aglovan’s mind as they stood before the first of the four ancient tombs. The air was thick with the scent of decay, the entrance lined with runes long since dulled by time. Somewhere inside lay a fragment of the amulet, hidden away by desperate hands as the temple fell.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/8342871ac9c038bacb99fdc570bc0db279b33ad3.png[/img]
The group pressed forward, their torches casting wavering light against the stone walls. Every shadow seemed to move, every whisper carried the weight of the dead. The first chamber was eerily silent, but the second was not so kind—skeletal warriors rose from their slumber, their empty eyes burning with unnatural light.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/9adf10e70c1733e9081e9d083c4cc58eb11073fa.png[/img]
Tomb by tomb, battle by battle, they reclaimed the lost pieces. Each fragment seemed unremarkable on its own, but as they fit them together, a deep crimson light pulsed from the central gem. At first faint, but with each step closer to their goal, it grew stronger, guiding them toward Alaris’s domain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/63f7ae4d711c4ff0a1fe135de2fd5c432713c759.png[/img]
The final tomb held the fiercest resistance yet, but at last, the amulet was whole again. Aglovan held it up, and for the first time, the veil over their path began to lift. The way to Alaris’s tower was no longer hidden—it was time to face whatever lay ahead.

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/d17a88d26d3dbc7d79b84b7e3205599d042ead98.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/eb9bdd7501f1c6c68195a45bf8cda19dec88c02e.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Lore Piece #15.1: The Clairvoyant
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/9792d39818744c327c6037f28a8f81822feb990b.png[/img]

[b]Unveiling the Hidden Tower[/b]

The journey to the ice desert was as treacherous as the warnings had foretold. Aglovan and his companions pushed forward against the biting cold, their breath forming misty clouds in the frigid air. At last, nestled in a remote cavern, they found the one they sought—a frail woman, her eyes as white as the snow outside, yet filled with an unsettling knowing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/c742b4c4f25add2cd753df3161fcb69f9af81fd5.png[/img]
She let out a raspy chuckle upon hearing of Alaris’s magical veil. "That fool always thought himself clever," she muttered. "But I taught him everything he knows." Her words hinted at a history long buried, a connection between master and student now turned to rivalry.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/5da92a6edd09136618a82a4766157843e4e6d8da.png[/img]
The seer agreed to help, but the ritual would take time—and time was not on their side. No sooner had she begun to draw sigils in the frost than the howls of the Undead echoed across the frozen plains. Alaris’s minions had arrived, drawn to the ancient magics at play.

The battle was fierce, the cold biting as much as the enemy’s steel. But as the last Undead fell, the air around them shifted. The veil hiding Alaris’s tower flickered, and for the first time, Aglovan could see a path forward. With a final incantation, the clairvoyant ensured their vision would not fail again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/816758d63218a06f195ec190120c36763c6361c1.png[/img]
But her assistance did not end there. With the battlefield strewn with corpses, she turned to her ancient tomes, whispering arcane words. The fallen had left them scars, but perhaps their sacrifice would strengthen the army yet…

notes.notes:
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/333549967681e2933af61dd9b70abd7beba36fab.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/111fc006d4d8a26227a98a4617ae0b599add6c02.png[/img][/url]

[b]DevBlog #31 – February 6, 2025[/b]

[b]New Lore Piece Tomorrow! 📜[/b]
The next episode in Aglovan’s journey is coming tomorrow! Expect more mysteries, twists, and a step closer to the grand finale. Stay tuned!

[b]Partnership with Indie.io 🎉[/b]
We’re excited to remind you about our partnership with Indie.io! With this, we have a brand-new store page, and Shields of Loyalty is reaching more players than ever! This collaboration is a big step toward making the game a success.

[b]Your Support Matters![/b]
Indie games thrive on community support. Wishlisting, sharing, and playing the game means everything to us. Let’s make Shields of Loyalty the best game it can be together!

[h3]Frequently Asked Questions[/h3]

📌 [b]Will the game support Japanese, Chinese, Korean, and Russian?[/b]
Yes! These languages are listed on our Steam page but are not fully implemented or proofread yet. With the help of our publisher and our team, all listed languages will be included and properly proofread by the 1.0 release.

📌 [b]When is the full release?[/b]
We are trying to make the game even better with our publisher and right now, our target is the Q2 2025.

📌 [b]Will there be modding support?[/b]
We love the idea of modding! While it’s not a feature for 1.0, we are exploring the possibilities for future updates.

[b]Gameplay & Features[/b]

📌 [b]Will there be multiplayer or co-op?[/b]
Right now, Shields of Loyalty is a single-player experience. We love multiplayer strategy games, but implementing it properly takes time. It’s something we’d consider post-launch if demand is high!

📌 [b]How long will a full campaign playthrough take?[/b]
On average, a full campaign can take 20-30 hours, depending on difficulty settings and playstyle.

📌 [b]Is there a difficulty setting?[/b]
Yes! We will offer multiple difficulty levels to ensure the game is accessible to all players while still challenging veterans of the genre at the 1.0 release.

📌 [b]Are there different factions to play?[/b]
While the campaign follows 3 unique playable factions, the world of Shields of Loyalty is threatened by an undead enemy faction which also has unique abilities and units.

📌 [b]How does the spell system work?[/b]
Spells are strategic abilities that can turn the tide of battle. They consume mana, and each spell has unique effects, ranging from healing to powerful attacks and battlefield manipulation.

[b]Development & Future Updates[/b]

📌 [b]Will there be controller support?[/b]
Right now, Shields of Loyalty is optimized for keyboard and mouse.

📌 [b]Will the game release on consoles?[/b]
We are currently focused on the PC version, but we are open to exploring console releases if there is demand. Our second release focus will be on the Nintendo Switch port.

📌 [b]Are you considering an endless or roguelike mode?[/b]
This has been suggested by some players, and we love the idea! It’s not in the initial release plan, but we’re keeping an eye on potential expansions. We will be mostly focusing on extra scenarios and our map editor so players can create and share their unique missions.

📌 [b]How can I help with development?[/b]
The best way to help is by reporting bugs, giving feedback, and spreading the word about the game. Join our Discord server and participate in discussions!

📌 [b]How can I become a beta tester?[/b]
We are always looking for passionate players to help test the game. If you’re interested, reach out on our Discord or keep an eye out for recruitment posts!

[b]📌 Why is feedback so important right now?[/b]
Shields of Loyalty 0.9 is now playable, and we’re fixing so many things that some details may be overlooked. Your bug reports and feedback are crucial to making the game the best it can be!

If you want to help us achieve our dream, please share your feedback in our #playtest-report channel:
👉 [url=https://discord.gg/WhTTddC4]Discord Server[/url]

💬 Let us know your thoughts and questions in the comments!

[i]For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. notes.title: Lore Piece #14: The Temple
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/7c5448056331a83f6d59fb7dae102b9a687fa26a.png[/img]

[b]Fragments of the Hidden Path[/b]

As Aglovan and his companions pressed on after their victory in Therwall, whispers of Alaris's tower began to resurface. Located at the misty seaside cliffs, the tower was said to be hidden by a powerful spell, rendering it invisible to all but the bearer of a mysterious amulet. Their path seemed clear, but securing the amulet would be anything but simple.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/a00af10fe710157b79f16d18faa9952c2a14a4e9.png[/img]
The group reached a crumbling temple, cloaked in eerie silence. Faint beams of sunlight filtered through shattered windows, casting strange shadows over the ruins. The only sign of life was a withered priest, his face pale and his body thin from years of isolation. Bound by an ancient vow, he had willingly sealed half his being behind a stone wall to remain undisturbed in his endless prayers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/49c7895a355a7530d95056120d93ebaa0f29e675.png[/img]
Despite his reluctance, the priest revealed a crucial truth: the amulet had been shattered and its fragments scattered to four sacred sites. The locations were veiled in secrecy, known only to a long-forgotten clairvoyant who dwelled in the treacherous ice desert far to the north. As a final plea to be left alone, the priest whispered an ominous warning: "The path to Alaris’s tower is fraught with trials, each more perilous than the last. Choose wisely where you tread, or you may never return."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/b23b395059d56530a9cd27da2e462b7ef8fa58af.png[/img]
With this cryptic knowledge, Aglovan and his companions set out to locate the fragments. But time was of the essence. Alaris’s plans were already in motion, and their window to thwart him was narrowing. The party steeled themselves for the trials ahead, knowing that the path to the clairvoyant—and ultimately the tower—would demand more than just courage.

notes.notes:
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/333549967681e2933af61dd9b70abd7beba36fab.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/111fc006d4d8a26227a98a4617ae0b599add6c02.png[/img][/url]

[b]DevBlog #30 – January 23, 2025[/b]

Hello, loyal players and supporters!

We’re excited to share updates on what’s coming to Shields of Loyalty. In case you missed it, here’s a quick recap of what we’ve been working on, plus some news about Update 0.9 and beyond!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/239b998c5fff44f3975438ff7531cc8f84e92995.png[/img]

[h3]What’s Coming in Update 0.9 (January 29th)[/h3]

Mark your calendars because Update 0.9 is right around the corner! We’ve been working tirelessly to enhance the game, and this patch will include some significant improvements. Along with these changes, we’ll also share some surprise news about the future of Shields of Loyalty. Stay tuned for the announcement alongside the update—you won’t want to miss it!

[h3]Localization and Language Proofreading[/h3]

We’ve heard your feedback about translations and are dedicated to improving the game’s localization. Our goal is to proofread and polish all existing supported languages, add new ones, and make the game accessible to as many players as possible around the globe.

However, we’re currently prioritizing core game development to finalize the most critical aspects of gameplay. With new systems like the spell mechanic, we’ve added many new terms to localize and verify. Rest assured, language support is on our list, but it’s not our main focus at the moment.

Good news: one of our beta testers has already helped with French text proofreading, and the results are fantastic! A huge thank you to our community members who assist us in these efforts. We’re always looking for volunteers to help with localization and proofreading—if you’d like to contribute, especially before the 1.0 release, let us know!

[h3]Spell System Updates and Teasers[/h3]

As part of Update 0.9, we’ll reveal three more spells with GIFs and full tooltips:

[list]
[*] [b]Bravery:[/b] Adds +2 movement points.
[*] [b]Willpower:[/b] Grants an additional attack or spell.
[*] [b]Pain of the Righteous:[/b] Deals 40 magical damage.
[/list]

[b][i]Bravery[/i][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/9900862beaa72ae103a92333b22202497c8bcf38.gif[/img]

[b][i]Willpower[/i][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/64d375ecafd918d00f787a679712659a473851c2.gif[/img]

[b][i]Pain of the Righteous[/i][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/00bddfb43c61e8f65f90229d98f526208a27240d.gif[/img]

In addition, we’ve added tooltips for older spells from previous sneak peeks so you can check out their full effects. Here are the tooltips for some spells shared in DevBlogs #29 and earlier:

[list]
[*] [b]Fireball:[/b] Deals 40 HP damage plus 10 HP burn damage for 3 rounds.
[*] [b]Freeze:[/b] Cannot move or attack for 2 rounds; all defensive stats are halved for 1 round.
[*] [b]Gust of Wind:[/b] Pushes the target unit back one space and stuns it for one round. Stunned units cannot attack, defend, cast spells, or use special abilities.
[*] [b]Locust Swarm:[/b] Affected enemy units cannot use magic, special abilities, or other actions except their standard attack for 5 turns. Damage is capped at 50HP for all attacks during this time.
[*] [b]Thorns:[/b] Deals 50 HP damage.
[*] [b]Hope:[/b] Increases attack by +1 and defense by 10% for all types.
[/list]

Check out the tooltips for these spells in our previous posts:

DevBlog #29
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1318240/view/523080695502865064

A Fresh Start for Shields of Loyalty: Welcome Back!
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1318240/view/520828168477606322

Stay tuned for GIFs showcasing the new spells!

[h3]Lore Piece #14: Aglovan’s Story Continues[/h3]

Lore lovers, rejoice! The next lore installment will continue Aglovan’s journey as his story approaches its thrilling conclusion. Keep an eye out for the update to dive deeper into the world of Shields of Loyalty.

[h3]New Forum Channel: #playtest-reports[/h3]

Thanks to our beta tester Cantora, we’ve added a new channel to our Discord server: #playtest-reports. This forum will help track existing issues, suggestions, and bugs. While it’s primarily used by beta testers during development, we’ll rely on your feedback after the 0.9 release to squash bugs and fine-tune the game. Big thanks to Cantora for the suggestion!

[h3]Your Support Means Everything[/h3]

We’re as eager as you are to see Shields of Loyalty reach its full potential. Your support, belief, and patience keep us motivated. Wishlist and share the game with your friends—it makes a massive difference for indie developers like us.

[b]Wishlist here:[/b] bit.ly/SoLWishlist

Thank you for being on this journey with us. Let’s make Shields of Loyalty the best it can be—together!

See you in-game soon,
The Shields of Loyalty Team

notes.title: Lore Piece #13: Therwall
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/f87f74192ba68967cb0ac2b3db3c974f551c6847.png[/img]
Therwall, the crown jewel of King Eldric II’s realm, has stood as an impenetrable bastion for centuries. Its towering walls, carved from the unyielding stone of the icy north, have withstood countless assaults from enemies both mortal and monstrous. But now, the castle faces its greatest challenge yet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/7645ef4f5a6e35cbe31eac6c1f3355e0008570cd.png[/img]
Among the attacking forces stands a name whispered with both fear and sorrow—Prince Desmon. Once a trusted hero of the realm and a loyal servant to Eldric II, Desmon’s betrayal cuts deeper than any sword. Years ago, he declared himself prince and attempted to overthrow the King, but his rebellion was crushed. Now, he returns, commanding the Undead horde in a twisted bid for power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/bfc647b2f2f08f780c206857e53f51f58f46ecab.png[/img]
As we approach Therwall, the scene is one of chaos and carnage. The castle walls are scorched and battered, but they hold—for now. The enemy swarms like locusts, their siege engines hurling fire and destruction. Desmon’s Captain, a shadowy figure cloaked in dark armour, orchestrates the assault with ruthless efficiency, directing waves of skeletal warriors against the defenders.

The battle is fierce and unrelenting. Our forces clash with the Undead in a desperate bid to break their siege. The air is thick with the acrid stench of burning wood and the metallic tang of blood. Finally, after what feels like an eternity, the attackers are driven back. The Captain falls, his dark armour shattered, and the Undead retreat into the night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/487b756ee16e74c921103f5a545388c890b477d7.png[/img]
But our victory is bittersweet. There is still no sign of Prince Desmon, and the King’s fears remain. Eldric II has ordered us to seek out Alaris, his most trusted advisor and a powerful magician. Alaris, however, is a figure of controversy—once Desmon’s ally, he urged the King to dismiss the realm’s heroes following Desmon’s rebellion. Can we truly trust him to aid us now? With heavy hearts, we set out to find the magician, knowing the fate of Therwall and the entire realm hangs in the balance.


⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/d17a88d26d3dbc7d79b84b7e3205599d042ead98.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/eb9bdd7501f1c6c68195a45bf8cda19dec88c02e.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Lore Piece #12.2: War Equipment
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/62f0921ee6ce754b9123e4ed8b43978b34d04749.png[/img]
As the siege of Therwall rages on, reports from the frontlines grow increasingly dire. The Undead are not content with sheer numbers alone; they are crafting terrible siege engines to batter down the castle walls and reduce Therwall to rubble. Their foul workshops are scattered throughout the frozen wilderness, hidden among the shadows of ancient trees and jagged cliffs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/fc0d565c08a2fdd9c52e2f74035af68a8a40cc8b.png[/img]
Our mission is clear: we must strike at the heart of their operations and destroy these war machines before they can be brought to bear against our defences. But the task ahead is daunting. These workshops are heavily guarded, and the Undead have fortified their positions with traps and barriers that test our resolve at every turn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/41a4398f8cf6228f9fa07a6a9bdd0cee4490b647.png[/img]
Under the cover of darkness, we begin our assault. The eerie glow of forge fires lights our path as we approach the first workshop. Inside, skeletal workers toil endlessly, assembling catapults and battering rams with unnatural precision. The clash of steel and the roar of flames fill the night as we strike with everything we have, setting their infernal machines ablaze.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/118511236224f26fbbe6401c773fc5e833097cbd.png[/img]
One by one, the workshops fall. The firelight dances against the snow, a grim beacon of our success. Yet, even as we return victorious, a shadow of doubt looms over us. The enemy’s numbers are vast, and Therwall’s defenders grow weary. The destruction of their war equipment has bought us precious time, but the fate of the castle—and the realm—remains uncertain.


⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/d17a88d26d3dbc7d79b84b7e3205599d042ead98.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/eb9bdd7501f1c6c68195a45bf8cda19dec88c02e.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Lore Piece #12.1: New Troops
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/eb9f2758ad073080b497a22505a57801747ac96c.png[/img]
The chilling reports from our scouts confirm King Eldric II’s worst fears: the Undead have begun their march toward Therwall in terrifying numbers. These newly raised warriors are a twisted parody of life, their skeletal forms clad in decaying armour and wielding rusted weapons that still drip with malevolent energy. They march with an unnatural purpose, their hollow eyes burning with an eerie, green glow that sends shivers down the spines of even our most seasoned soldiers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/2c9109988dda8ee79d6fd25bdc0bfc466699b318.png[/img]
King Eldric has entrusted us with a vital mission—to intercept this monstrous army before it reaches the castle walls. With Therwall already under siege, the arrival of these reinforcements could tip the balance in the enemy’s favour, dooming the entire realm to darkness. As we prepare for battle, the weight of our task settles heavily on us. There is no room for hesitation; the survival of our people depends on the swift destruction of this new threat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/7e17d0e3cd72de7dc85e62d31d470adf2a2d5cde.png[/img]
After days of relentless pursuit, we finally catch up to the Undead horde in a frostbitten valley shrouded in mist. The ground beneath us seems to crackle with malevolence, and the air is thick with the stench of decay. The battle that ensues is nothing short of a nightmare, a desperate clash of steel and bone. The Undead fight without fear or fatigue, but we press on, driven by the knowledge of what’s at stake.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/2c04114b68fe7005919551a4bdd5ccc171e9f5fc.png[/img]
At last, the tide turns. Whatever dark magic had animated these abominations is extinguished, their brittle bodies collapsing into lifeless heaps. The valley falls silent, save for the heavy breathing of our exhausted warriors. But victory is fleeting; we have no time to rest or celebrate. Therwall’s fate remains uncertain, and we must return to its defence before it’s too late.

notes.notes:
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/333549967681e2933af61dd9b70abd7beba36fab.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/111fc006d4d8a26227a98a4617ae0b599add6c02.png[/img][/url]

Hello, Loyal Shields!

First off, Happy New Year! 🎉

We know you've been eagerly awaiting updates on Shields of Loyalty. I want to thank you for your patience over the past month. As many of you know, I recently moved to Germany and had some personal matters to sort out. Now, I'm back, and I’m here to reignite the excitement as we march closer to our anticipated release!

[h2]Let’s address the big question:[/h2]
Yes, our plan is to have a release window between March and April 2025. Rest assured, our team is fully committed to delivering the game you've been waiting for. Thanks to our newest developer, progress has sped up considerably!

[h2]Exciting Updates:[/h2]

[h3]Beta-Tester Branch:[/h3] A big update just dropped for the beta branch and is just around the corner! Newly added spells have been [b]implemented [/b] and are waiting for testers.

[h3]The Third Island and Faction:[/h3] Our team is working at full speed to bring this final piece of the game to life.

Thank you for your unwavering support and trust. We’re dedicated to making Shields of Loyalty everything you’ve dreamed of—and more. Let’s make 2025 our year!

Cheers,

notes.title: Lore Pieces #11
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/95c566db2d3943b2040341a12f494e3e7bce27c2.png[/img]
The loud screams of pain that can be heard from a distance every now and then pierce marrow and bone, rattling even the toughest of our men. The Undead have taken over the old dungeon of this icy island, torturing prisoners. We must act swiftly to free these poor souls before they reveal secrets that could endanger Therwall itself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/a88b19bdb1c61f0f3b6896aca733f3ab0046df15.png[/img]
Our journey into the frozen depths of the dungeon began with a cacophony of suffering that hung in the air like a haunting melody. The eerie glow of ghostly torches illuminated the cold stone walls, etched with the scratches of countless prisoners. The Undead minions patrolling these halls showed no mercy, but our forces pressed on, undeterred by the overwhelming darkness.

In the depths of this cursed dungeon, we faced Count Astaroth, a terrifying adversary whose mere presence sent chills down the spines of our warriors. Towering and cruel, Astaroth commanded his minions with a voice that reverberated like thunder in these confined spaces. After a harrowing battle, Aglovan struck the final blow, and the Count fell, his wretched scream echoing through the corridors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/6fb8474216fa47178e737a5f3b409f1e3c1c464b.png[/img]
Among the freed prisoners was a messenger from Eldric II. He brought dire news: Castle Therwall is under siege. But the King’s greater worry lies in reports that the enemy is preparing reinforcements—new warriors or powerful equipment that could tip the balance of war. The messenger’s warning leaves us with no choice; our path to Therwall will be fraught with peril, but it must be taken.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/d89f5060a903eaddb9e3633b17d52e19a2cf3e42.png[/img]
The rescue mission has bought us valuable time, but the stakes have never been higher. The messenger’s words weigh heavily on us as we march onward, knowing that any delay could spell doom for Therwall. We must stay vigilant and strong, for the fate of the realm may depend on the choices we make next.

notes.title: Lore Pieces #10
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/34bc67ff16b13b3bd4c9020e215f8de0b852a826.png[/img]

Aglovan and his army emerged from the shimmering portal, stepping into an entirely new and hostile world. The Eternal Ice, an island shrouded in perpetual frost, stretched out before them. Snow-capped peaks loomed in the distance, and the chilling winds howled through frozen valleys. The air carried a biting cold, far removed from the scorched ruins of Darkwood, where they had battled Demon Lord Zepar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/8415983efdd87fb9088bbc11075435bf007405be.png[/img]
While our eyes were still adjusting to the cold light of this world made of ice, we could already discern their shadows right in front of us. They have been waiting for us because they know that we are attackable until the portal has allowed for all of our troops to travel to this isle.

The Undead, ever relentless, had not given up their pursuit of Aglovan's forces. A vanguard of skeletal warriors and frost-bound wraiths awaited their arrival, ready to strike as the portal's energy struggled to transport the full strength of Aglovan's army. With only a fraction of his troops assembled, Aglovan had no choice but to hold the line. The frozen battlefield provided little cover, and the enemy pressed forward with chilling resolve.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/25b2afc4199eb50f54e923e0d63121f23e9bab46.png[/img]
As more of Aglovan’s forces materialized from the portal, the tide began to turn. His heavy infantry braved the icy terrain to form a solid front, while archers rained arrows upon the advancing Undead. Cavalry forces charged through the battlefield, their swift movements disrupting the chilling curses of the wraiths as they scattered the enemy lines.

The sight of the arrival of our full army finally put the Undead warriors to flight, but nonetheless, we should stay on guard while we are pursuing them. Along the way right over cracking ice and moving past deep crevasses, a single misstep could already bode death...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/0703e4cb70a7b1e8dc79b79c38708519dec6053e.png[/img]
The Eternal Ice promised no reprieve, only harsher trials ahead. But Aglovan knew there was no turning back now. The answers to the mysteries of the Undead invasion lay somewhere within this frozen expanse.

notes.title: Lore Pieces #9
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/2ec12dad85e4d3db576fc08d3c62e35d323dcaa0.png[/img]

The flames danced ominously atop the walls of the once-mighty Bastion, their flickering glow a stark reminder of the destruction wrought by the Demon Lord Zepar. This ancient stronghold had stood against countless foes, its proud towers a symbol of strength and resilience. But now, it lay conquered, defiled by the relentless Undead hordes and their monstrous leader, a being of pure fire and malice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/9df22006a93f82fa0fe693b410614efe3ce458a5.png[/img]
Aglovan and his troops approached cautiously, their spirits weighed down by the sight of the fortress’s smouldering ruins. The road ahead led to the mysterious portal—a shimmering gateway that the enemy seemed determined to guard. Its very existence raised questions: Why was such a powerful artifact hidden here, and what purpose did it serve? Only one thing was certain—Zepar had to be stopped, and the Bastion reclaimed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/349c4c7075060efae86cf73648afb2aec4b722e3.png[/img]
The battle was brutal. Zepar’s fiery attacks rained destruction, forcing Aglovan and his forces to adapt quickly. The Undead soldiers, empowered by their master’s unholy flames, fought with a frenzy that tested even the bravest warriors. Aglovan’s command was crucial, rallying his troops in the face of overwhelming odds. Siege weapons, heavy infantry, and the monks who had joined the cause all played their part in the desperate struggle.

The Demon Lord’s demise was nothing short of a spectacle. With a final, thunderous roar, his massive form disintegrated, sending a shockwave of searing heat across the battlefield. Silence fell as the last echoes of his rage dissipated, leaving only the crackling of the remaining flames. The Bastion was ours once more.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/880a971738130026580bd2f83cba284c12f1e629.png[/img]

The portal stood at the heart of the stronghold, its shimmering light casting an ethereal glow over the ruined courtyard. None among us had ever seen such a thing. Legends spoke of portals that could transport one across vast distances in an instant, but to witness it in reality was breathtaking. The Bastion’s riches—gold, gems, and artifacts—were gathered, a small consolation for the lives lost and the destruction endured.

As Aglovan stepped closer to the portal, the uncertainty of what lay beyond mingled with a newfound determination. The island of Eternal Ice awaited, promising new challenges, new enemies, and perhaps answers to the mysteries of the Undead invasion. The journey was far from over.

With the Bastion secured and the portal beckoning, Aglovan and his troops prepared to take their next step into the unknown. The battle for Mantaria had only just begun.

[h2]Introducing Tier 3 Undead Units – Elemental and Magical Power Unleashed[/h2]

As we progress into the late stages of the campaign, prepare to face these powerful foes that bring specialized strengths and unique abilities, ensuring an intense and challenging fight.

[h3]Undead Tier 3 Units:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/61210f6f5c227da7a56b2adaa9a35ba92cc4b7f6.png[/img]
    [h3]Light Infantry: Witches[/h3] - Channeling elemental damage, these eerie units bring elemental damage to weaken your forces, wreaking havoc on unprepared armies.
    [h3]Heavy Infantry: Demons[/h3] - Infused with dark magic, these towering demons deal magical damage capable of strong attakcs, turning your strongest units into vulnerable targets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/38ccc94b56d542745392dcf47fb3098ee77c535e.png[/img]
    [h3]Light Cavalry: Ghost Riders[/h3] - Mounted on spectral steeds, these swift units deliver deadly elemental attacks, striking fear with their unpredictable charges.
   [h3] Heavy Cavalry: Hell Horses[/h3] - Enveloped in flame and darkness, Hell Horses are imbued with potent magical damage, trampling any who dare stand in their path.

These Tier 3 units represent the culmination of the Undead army’s strength and require keen strategy to overcome. Prepare your defenses and bring your best units if you hope to stand against them!

[h2]Lore Piece #9: The Portal - The Last Stand at Darkwood[/h2]

Following the story choices made in Lore Piece #8.1: The Monastery and #8.2: Treasure Hunt, we now arrive at the climactic mission that ties everything together. The Bastion, the proud and powerful stronghold of Darkwood, has fallen to the relentless hordes of the Undead. Only by retaking this fortress can we uncover the reason behind these monstrous attacks and face the infernal threat that lies ahead.

[h3]Mission Briefing – The Portal[/h3]

The Bastion was once the crown jewel of Darkwood’s defenses, a place of unmatched strength and protection. But even its walls have been torn down, overwhelmed by the relentless advance of the Undead, led by the fiery Demon Lord Zepar. This terrifying demon has brought flames and destruction in his wake, laying siege to all in his path. Now, there’s only one option: reclaim the Bastion and put an end to the invasion.

In Lore Piece #9, readers will see how Aglovan's earlier choices, whether defending the Monastery or gathering resources from the Treasure Hunt, influence their resources and allies in this pivotal mission. With the fate of Darkwood at stake, every choice made so far will echo in the battle to come.

[h3]Community Updates & Beta Testing[/h3]

[h3]We want to remind you:[/h3] Want to join the testing and help shape the game? Apply on our Discord server to become a beta tester and be part of our journey to the full release!

Your support is essential to our journey. If you haven’t already, please add Shields of Loyalty to your Steam wishlist to help our community grow and stay up-to-date with every new update. With your support, we can bring Shields of Loyalty to even more fans of strategy, lore, and epic battles.

Thank you for your loyalty and for standing by our side as we march toward the 1.0 release. There’s much more to come as we reach the epic end of Darkwood and beyond!

Until next time, Commanders—brace yourselves and prepare for battle!

The Shields of Loyalty Team

notes.title: Lore Pieces #8.2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/ad21267a58d3b177f17ec61eb7266575e9ce4435.png[/img]

Our path had become a trail of sorrow and loss. Each time we encountered refugees—families clutching little more than each other or the clothes on their backs—we were reminded of the devastation left by the undead scourge. Homes reduced to hollow shells, fields stripped of life, and belongings abandoned in the desperate rush for survival were common sights. The refugees had carried only what was essential, leaving behind a life’s worth of memories and treasures.

Yet in their gratitude for our help, some offered us guidance toward valuables they’d had to abandon. They spoke of hidden caches of jewelry, family heirlooms, and metal relics, nestled in the ruins of homes or buried near their lands. These scattered treasures, they told us, could aid us if we dared to reclaim them from the forsaken villages now infested with lurking undead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/0d83cba8d521405c9ec428c2b63a5ede3d294460.png[/img]
With heavy hearts and resolute spirits, we ventured into these desolate places. The towns and villages were eerie, cloaked in silence except for the whispering wind that blew through hollowed-out homes and scorched fields. The walls bore signs of frantic, last-ditch defenses; furniture lay overturned, some splintered into makeshift barricades. Yet among the broken beams and forgotten rooms, precious remnants of the past gleamed in the dim light.

In one home, a silver mirror remained unbroken, reflecting only shadows. Another held a forgotten chest under a shattered staircase, with coins and small trinkets still inside. Some treasures were hidden more securely, in cellars or behind bricks, left with hope they’d survive the carnage. The undead had no use for these things and had left them untouched. These treasures, however, held great value for us. They would be melted down, reforged, and repurposed—transformed from cherished possessions into a lifeline for our soldiers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/669723d4d3e0becc024a7c511b92134b993df9de.png[/img]
As we gathered what we could, it became clear just how much potential lay within these ruins. Though sorrowful, these metals would become powerful weapons, shields, and armor, empowering us to press forward. It was as if the memories and sacrifices bound within these items gave us strength, fortifying our cause with every sword reforged from them. The undead, driven by their mindless hunger, could never understand the value of what they had left behind. But soon enough, they would face the consequences of their ignorance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/01c38eb917db541dae25c503aeb361793a4bfc08.png[/img]
The refugees moved on, leaving their pasts behind to forge new lives elsewhere. Yet they had given us something invaluable—both their trust and the materials we needed to continue our struggle. With our wagons now loaded with precious metals and relics, we left those ravaged villages, determined to turn sorrow into strength, despair into defiance, and to meet the undead with weapons forged from the remnants of everything they had tried to destroy.

notes.title: Lore Pieces #8.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/8f6584a93c58a8cb1429ee6eec9b3d654a2740f5.png[/img]

After the fierce confrontation on The Battlefield, our journey diverged. Seeking refuge and allies, we pressed toward an old monastery on the outskirts, hoping to find aid in its sanctified halls. Here, we encountered monks who had once thrived in peaceful seclusion, undisturbed by the outside world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/5aaf7380af10171a70b974afb8323e32a0bfef2e.png[/img]
When these monks built their sanctuary, they intended it as a place of quiet devotion, removed from the realm of swords and bloodshed. But now, their isolation had become a peril. With undead forces inching ever closer, their prayers alone would not suffice. Against this relentless foe, the monks needed steel as much as spirit.

Our arrival became a lifeline. The monks met us with quiet resolve, quickly blessing our weapons, and even shared what little they had left from their dwindling supplies. Together, we readied defenses, our soldiers fortified by the monks’ sacred chants. As dusk fell, the first wave of the undead surged forward. The monks stood with us, chanting hymns that seemed to thicken the very air, strengthening our resolve as the undead clawed at the gates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/817dff88df9e69f4e40c99dbe965bfa7bdf45de6.png[/img]
Battle cries mingled with prayers, and each clash of steel rang out with a blessed resonance, as though the walls themselves protected us. Hours passed under relentless waves, but as exhaustion began to weigh on us, a glimmer of hope appeared. Reinforcements from Rifthain arrived just in time, storming in to bolster our numbers and push back the tide. Together, we forced the final wave into retreat, leaving the holy ground untouched by the stench of the undead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/4ce9c873752babb965a9104a73520865f26f081f.png[/img]
In deep gratitude for our defense of their sanctuary, some of the monks made the ultimate sacrifice and broke their vows to join our cause, swearing their loyalty. Blessed by the monks’ sacred rites and equipped with their last belongings, our company left the monastery fortified and invigorated, its prayers and relics now fueling our fight.

notes.title: Lore Pieces #7
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/36276699186c78c095c596a79036fc2bedc868a6.png[/img]

The morning was shrouded in an unnatural mist, thick and dark as if infused with the essence of the dead. Aglovan’s forces stood shoulder to shoulder, weapons drawn, eyes fixed on the shifting shadows ahead. The undead army gathered, filling the air with an unbearable stench and a bone-chilling silence. Then, out of the mist, Princess Vapula emerged.

Once a noble figure of beauty, she now embodied decay itself: hollow eyes glowing with the cold fire of vengeance, a twisted grin revealing teeth sharp as daggers. Behind her stretched an army, a sea of skeletal warriors clanking their rusted armor, their lifeless gazes fixed on Aglovan and his men. This was no mere battle; this was the last stand against an unholy force intent on dragging them all into the abyss.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/a32c206625cc08452b078a5aa8c2a6ea8384f6cc.png[/img]
With a swift command, Aglovan raised his sword, and the clash began.

The undead surged forward, their bony limbs wielding ancient weapons as if controlled by a single mind. Vapula hovered behind them, her outstretched claws weaving spells that filled the air with a crackling hum. Aglovan could feel her dark magic probing his thoughts, her voice whispering ancient curses meant to dishearten and scatter his men.

“Stand firm!” he roared, his voice cutting through the cacophony of steel and death. His forces pushed forward, driving their spears and swords into bone and rotting flesh. Each swing shattered the undead ranks, but for every one that fell, two more rose in its place, animated by Vapula’s dark power.

Then, in a daring move, Aglovan broke through the lines, charging directly at the necromantic princess. She let out an unearthly shriek as he approached, her wings spreading wide as she descended upon him, claws ready to tear his very soul apart. They clashed—her talons against his blade, her necrotic strength against his will.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/9647e886967b4bfc24229a67c6a057b5c196bd07.png[/img]
The ground itself seemed to tremble as they fought, Vapula’s magic lashing out like venomous tendrils, attempting to ensnare Aglovan. But he fought with purpose, each strike aimed not just to kill but to vanquish the evil that had twisted her being. Their battle raged, neither side willing to yield.

At last, with a swift and final blow, Aglovan’s blade found its mark, slicing through the decayed flesh and brittle bones that bound Vapula to this world. She let out one final, wretched scream as her form crumbled, disintegrating into dust. Her spell broken, the undead warriors collapsed, their cursed lives extinguished at last.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/c27d4a6420ff1b31636e73f1bcc6b2ef77a4cf03.png[/img]
As the battlefield finally fell silent, Aglovan’s men moved through the smoky haze, scanning for any sign of what drove Vapula and her relentless undead horde. But there was nothing—no lair, no clues, only the remnants of the fallen, slowly crumbling back into dust. The mystery of the dark force that controlled her lingered, elusive as ever.
