notes.title: Lore Pieces #6
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/6c7e6e9898af63d0ddf7194924b4b5f04efca6b5.png[/img]

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[h1]The Battlefield[/h1]

⠀⠀⠀Dawn broke cold and grey over the ancient border wall. Aglovan’s men, weary but resolute, emerged from their rest, each casting wary glances over the stone ramparts they had so recently fought to defend. The night had given them brief respite, but even as the sun’s first rays cut through the mist, an uneasy silence hung heavy in the air. The journey was far from over. Word had spread among the ranks—this was only a taste of what lay ahead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/c09d2a449144ed3c9a623b8f12a8483772336d90.png[/img]
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀It was here, upon this very ground, that one of the kingdom’s most brutal battles had taken place. Years ago, thousands had clashed and fallen in the Last Battle, as King Eldric II led his forces against the insurgent army of Prince Desmon. What had once been a decisive victory had now become a cursed relic of the past, a place where the dead refused to rest. And with every passing moment, their numbers swelled as Princess Vapula’s dark influence seeped into the earth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/02ffa124b84e19abafc05e193cc387ddcafe915d.png[/img]
⠀⠀Aglovan surveyed his men, noting the exhaustion etched on their faces. Yet they were undeterred. “This place holds the memory of blood and sacrifice,” he began, his voice steady, “but we must not let it become a field of the living dead. Today, we move to confront the source.”

⠀⠀⠀⠀The scouts reported signs of fresh disturbances among the burial grounds beyond the wall. Shallow graves lay scattered, as if the earth itself had turned against the fallen, casting them out. Cracked bones, shattered armor, and the faint traces of old banners told stories of warriors from both sides, now twisted and lifeless. The enemy was close—too close.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/1b160d1ad638af8764a155050277f62ee6fd81b3.png[/img]
⠀⠀The journey to reach the heart of this necromantic scourge would not be easy. Princess Vapula’s undead forces had only strengthened, and every step forward meant facing the fallen souls who once defended these lands. Yet Aglovan’s resolve was clear. “We stand here today to fight not only for the kingdom’s future but to reclaim the honor of those who have been robbed of their eternal rest.”

⠀⠀⠀⠀And so, with shields raised and hearts hardened, they prepared to enter The Battlefield, knowing full well that the very ground they walked upon was steeped in death. Every warrior sensed it—a chill creeping up their spines, a silent acknowledgment that the dead were watching, waiting. It was now their task to ensure that the past did not become a new weapon wielded by their enemies.

notes.title: ⚔️ Tactical Tuesday ⚔️
notes.notes:
Let’s explore some unique facts about Turn-Based Strategy (TBS) games and why they continue to capture the imagination of players! 💡

Slow and Steady Wins the Race:
Unlike real-time strategy games, TBS allows players to make more calculated, thoughtful decisions. This “no pressure” style of gameplay makes it perfect for players who prefer strategy over speed! 🧠

Influencing the Real World:
Some TBS games, like XCOM or Civilization, have been used in military and educational contexts to teach strategic thinking and decision-making. TBS games aren’t just for fun—they're practical tools for learning! 🎓

You vs. Yourself:
In many TBS games, the biggest challenge isn't just defeating the enemy—it's mastering your own strategies. Games like Advance Wars or Total War series make players refine their plans constantly. 🚩

Endless Replayability:
The randomness and dynamic nature of many TBS maps and scenarios mean no two games are ever alike. This is a hallmark of the genre—players can enjoy different challenges each time they play. ♾️

From Ancient Civilizations to Alien Worlds:
TBS games offer a wide variety of settings, from historical epics like Civilization to sci-fi adventures like XCOM. Each universe brings its own set of tactical challenges and opportunities. 🌌

Shields of Loyalty builds on these timeless principles, adding deep unit synergies and rich lore-based tactical gameplay. How do you think TBS games can evolve further? Share your thoughts below! ✍️

📰 Don’t forget—Lore Piece 6 is coming later this week, so stay tuned for more story-driven content! 🌍

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/4c1fafc855e691984a535d6aacff348fc0cd5c05.png[/img]

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[h1]The Chokepoint[/h1]

⠀⠀⠀⠀The night had been long, restless. Even after the triumph at Rifthain, the weight of the journey ahead pressed down on Aglovan’s shoulders. The path leading from the city was narrow, hemmed in by thick underbrush and towering trees, dark and foreboding. Every step felt like an invitation for something unseen to strike from the shadows. His men, usually resolute, now walked in uneasy silence. Their ears strained at every sound: a crack of a branch, the rustle of leaves, the distant caw of a bird. Yet, nothing felt natural.

⠀⠀⠀⠀Were they truly alone?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/473a0c01d3e21bbe994c21be813b901bdb151420.png[/img]
⠀⠀⠀Aglovan halted, raising a hand to signal a stop. The front ranks came to a standstill, their eyes wide with the same question on their minds. Were those just animals in the brush? Or something far worse?
The silence was broken by a scream. The sharp cry echoed from somewhere in the back. A moment later, the enemy was upon them.

⠀⠀⠀⠀"They’re here!" someone shouted. And they were – swarming from the shadows, out of the underbrush, from unseen corners of the forest. Skeleton warriors, eyes glowing with a cold, malevolent light, charged from every direction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/bfe6316335c6e6292ef5b73238af24c94a6d98a9.png[/img]
⠀⠀⠀Aglovan’s sword flashed out, meeting bone with steel, but the enemy was relentless. We’re trapped, he realized. An easy prey in this cursed chokepoint.

⠀⠀⠀⠀His mind raced, searching for hope. Ahead lay the only salvation – the old border wall. A relic from another time, its stones weathered but still standing firm. If they could reach it, they could fortify their position, fight back with purpose. But it lay far ahead, and time was slipping through their fingers.

⠀⠀⠀⠀“Form ranks! Keep pushing forward!” Aglovan’s voice boomed over the chaos as he sliced through the air. His men, seasoned as they were, struggled to fend off the continuous waves of the undead. For every one enemy struck down, another rose in its place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/275b49983fda3632a9fedbb3b10035338a607277.png[/img]
⠀⠀⠀⠀The path was narrow, their space limited. Here, in this chokepoint, they were vulnerable – but they couldn’t stop. Not now. Not with the enemy’s forces growing, threatening to overwhelm them.

⠀⠀⠀⠀With every step, the border wall loomed closer, but the enemy numbers didn’t thin. Their skeletal claws clutched at armor and shields, seeking to drag Aglovan’s men down into the cold earth. But the walls ahead promised safety. If they could only hold out some more, more moments of blood and steel, they might just make it.

⠀⠀⠀⠀And so they pressed on, inching forward, driven by the desperate hope of survival. The border wall stood as their last line of defense, their only chance to regroup and rally.
But the enemy would not make it easy. They never did.

[h3]Greetings, warriors of Mantaria![/h3]

We’re back with a special update as we inch closer to the much-anticipated 0.9 release! Things are heating up, and we’re thrilled to share exciting new content for the Warlord Faction. Along with some important updates from our graphic designers and coders, today’s DevBlog introduces unique Warlord faction buildings and spellcaster units, as well as new environmental and UI improvements. Let’s dive in!

[h1]🛠️Developer's Corner: 0.9 Is Almost Here![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/790dd9e230956652a8a8b60b6bc4d24534dda751.png[/img]

Our developers are hard at work as we approach version 0.9, which brings us ever closer to the full launch! Recent efforts have focused on [b]bug fixes[/b] and [b]polishing game mechanics[/b]. Our coders are optimizing performance and resolving any lingering issues to ensure a smooth, tactical experience for you all.

We’ve also been working hard on the [b]new unit management UI[/b]—you’ll notice it’s much more intuitive and visually appealing now. The newly redesigned [b]artifact system[/b] is especially eye-catching, with vibrant colors replacing the old grayscale look. These updates will make customizing and managing your units more enjoyable and easier than ever!

[h1]🎨 Graphic Designer Notes: Environmental and UI Improvements[/h1]

In the last few weeks, our graphic designers primarily focused on integrating and refining several key aspects of the game’s visuals, pushing for a more immersive and polished experience. Here’s what’s been going on:

[b]UI Refinements:[/b] We’ve made significant updates to the overall [b]User Interface[/b], particularly in the[b] main menu, Army Management, Artifacts[/b], and various in-game panels and screens. These improvements ensure a smoother and more visually appealing experience for players navigating through the game. Even the small details like mouse cursors have been reworked to fit the dark fantasy aesthetic.

[b]New In-Game Graphics:[/b] We’ve introduced fresh visuals for the [b]Darkwoods[/b] and [b]Eternal Ice[/b] environments, adding depth and enhancing the unique atmosphere of these regions. Expect to see richer textures, more detailed landscapes, and an overall improvement in the way these zones look and feel.

[b]Existing Graphics Refinement:[/b] The team has been hard at work refining [b]existing in-game graphics[/b]. Everything from unit models to terrain has been touched up to ensure consistency with our evolving visual style. We’ve focused on keeping the dark fantasy theme alive while enhancing clarity and detail.

[b]Shader Effects:[/b] To breathe more life into the environments, we’ve added [b]new shader effects[/b], particularly for vegetation, which now offers more variety and dynamism. This will bring an extra layer of realism and richness to the world, giving players a more vivid and engaging battlefield.

With these updates, we aim to create a visually cohesive and immersive experience that elevates gameplay. We’re excited to show you more as we move closer to release!

Now, the [b]artifact system[/b] has a splash of color, replacing the old grayscale design with vivid, unique visuals for each artifact. This update not only improves aesthetics but also helps players quickly identify and equip items during strategic planning.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/19d0d7d650010e00d6befe55a58de0e9f0d23229.png[/img]

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[h1]The City of Rifthain[/h1]

⠀⠀⠀⠀As the smoke from burning villages drifted into the sky, Aglovan’s gaze was fixed on the distant walls of Rifthain, now a fortress of the undead. The once-glorious city had become a dark stronghold, its proud spires crumbling under the weight of enemy corruption. Aglovan and his army had secured the shores and nearby ruins, but every step toward the city brought fiercer resistance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/04e0427aef497a1f06786213da37d2808a366e7b.png[/img]
⠀⠀⠀“Captain, the undead numbers are growing,” a soldier reported breathlessly. “Reinforcements are closing in from the east.”

Aglovan’s jaw tightened. The closer they came to Rifthain, the harder the enemy fought to hold it. But retreat was not an option. They had fought too hard to turn back now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/8882938e72a753173d660f6846755fefd40955fa.png[/img]
⠀⠀⠀⠀“We hold our ground,” Aglovan commanded. “Send word to the archers. Focus on the undead commanders, and we will thin their ranks. We need to push forward, or Rifthain will be lost forever.”

The sound of battle grew louder as Aglovan led his troops into the fray. Undead warriors swarmed from the city’s gates, but Aglovan’s forces stood strong, pushing back with everything they had. Every strike, every arrow, every spell was aimed at reclaiming Rifthain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/b689a3f34b635a0ca5f5cfec647876374f319bc6.png[/img]
⠀⠀⠀With each passing moment, the path to the city seemed longer, but Aglovan knew they were close. They had to break through, not only for the city but for all of Mantaria.

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/d17a88d26d3dbc7d79b84b7e3205599d042ead98.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/eb9bdd7501f1c6c68195a45bf8cda19dec88c02e.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Lore Pieces #3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/31495fecff5d5400767019106f590a89474ced47.png[/img]
[h1]Getting Ready to Embark #2[/h1]

⠀⠀⠀⠀The ship glided ashore, its hull scraping against the sands of Darkwoods. Aglovan disembarked, his gaze sweeping over the twisted landscape that was once his home. The thick, gnarled trees whispered of the evil that had taken root here. Darkwoods had fallen to the Undead, and if they were to reach Rifthain in time, they had to move quickly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/ccff1fe11898ff06a6f26fed76dfe44675fc295a.png[/img]
⠀⠀⠀⠀Gathering his soldiers, Aglovan issued swift orders. They would take the nearby villages and explore the ruins to establish a foothold before pressing onward. The Undead were marching toward Rifthain, and every moment of delay could seal the city's fate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/17e9aab461726b0a48fd8502c555a01ec811f5f0.png[/img]
⠀⠀⠀⠀With his troops at the ready, Aglovan led a small force into the first ruin. Inside, skeletal warriors awaited them, but the fight was swift. As their bones shattered to the ground, Aglovan pressed onward, his resolve unshaken.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/4efec1748324911f19647eb03f6423a671b5a5a0.png[/img]
⠀⠀⠀⠀By dusk, one village had been reclaimed, and the ruins had yielded valuable supplies. The army was making progress, but Aglovan knew the real battle lay ahead. The path to Rifthain had only just begun, and there was no room for failure.

"We move at dawn," Aglovan declared. "The Rifthain will be ours, or we will die trying."

notes.notes:
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/333549967681e2933af61dd9b70abd7beba36fab.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/111fc006d4d8a26227a98a4617ae0b599add6c02.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Greetings, Commanders![/h3]

In this week's DevBlog, we’ve got some exciting updates to share, including a new reskin of our Knight Faction leader Aglovan, two Warlord Faction buildings, and a sneak peek into what’s coming in next major update at the end of this month. Let’s dive in!

[h3]Upcoming Game Update: Version 0.9[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/790dd9e230956652a8a8b60b6bc4d24534dda751.png[/img]

We’re thrilled to announce at the end of this month, we’ll be releasing our biggest update yet—version 0.9. This update will include:

[h3]Playable Warlord Faction:[/h3] Take control of the fearsome Warlords and experience their unique playstyle.
[h3]New UIs:[/h3] A fresh user interface designed to improve usability and clarity in every aspect of the game.
[h3]Spell System:[/h3] Magic is coming! Unleash devastating spells on your enemies and manipulate the battlefield to your advantage.
[h3]New Island Map:[/h3] Explore an entirely new region of Mantaria with fresh challenges, resources, and lore to uncover.

This update brings us closer to the full launch, and we can't wait for you to experience all the new content and features!

[h3]Aglovan Reskin – The Knight Faction Leader[/h3]

Our hero, Aglovan, has gone through a bit of a transformation. After revisiting his design, we realized he needed a bit of an update to match the current state of our game. Now, Aglovan looks sharper, a little older, and ready to lead his people with renewed vigor. This new reskin ensures he fits more seamlessly with the game's evolving aesthetic and tone. We can’t wait for you to see him in action!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/1d42133683f2fb127dc28272f714a8c28d7d745b.png[/img]

[h3]New Warlord Faction Buildings: Hunter’s Hut & Beast Lodge[/h3]

In this update, we’re excited to introduce two new Warlord Faction buildings:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/f757e7ac28381131307b13fada12fa11e1358caf.png[/img]
[b]Hunter’s Hut:[/b] This building is key for training your ranged units. At [b]Tier 1[/b], you’ll start with [b]Spear Throwers[/b], basic but versatile units. As you upgrade the building to [b]Tier 2[/b], you gain access to the more advanced [b]Elven Bowmen[/b], known for their precision and range. Finally, at [b]Tier 3[/b], you’ll be able to recruit the powerful [b]Pyromaniacs[/b], units that combine fire and ranged attacks to wreak havoc on enemy lines.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/f17fb13472c5dba06ca4f8a4f1fe7b14016870d5.png[/img]
[b]Beast Lodge:[/b] Focused on cavalry units, the Beast Lodge starts with [b]Centaurs[/b] at [b]Tier 1[/b], swift and reliable for hit-and-run tactics. At [b]Tier 2[/b], you can train [b]Deer Riders[/b], units with enhanced mobility and strength. The final upgrade, [b]Tier 3[/b], unlocks the fearsome [b]Bear Riders[/b], cavalry units known for their immense power and durability in battle.

These buildings and units will provide crucial tactical advantages as you expand your Warlord forces!

[h3]Lore Piece #3 – Sneak Peek[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/31495fecff5d5400767019106f590a89474ced47.png[/img]

Lastly, we’re excited to tease our next Lore Piece, #3, which will be released soon. In this chapter, our hero Aglovan has finally reached the shores of Darkwoods with his army. As they prepare to face the enemy forces, the tension rises, and their first contact with the enemy sets the stage for an epic confrontation. Stay tuned for more lore details to immerse yourself further into the world of Mantaria!

That’s it for DevBlog 19! Stay tuned for next week’s massive update and the release of Lore Piece #3.

The Shields of Loyalty Team

notes.title: Lore Pieces #2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/6d134f03cd6827d0626b457db2bb963aca24a6db.png[/img]
[h1]Getting Ready to Embark #1[/h1]

⠀⠀⠀⠀The ship's hull groaned as it sliced through the misty waters, the distant outline of Darkwoods coming into focus. Aglovan stood at the bow, his eyes locked on the shadowy treeline that fringed the coast. The island loomed ahead, shrouded in an eerie stillness, as if the land itself held its breath in anticipation of the coming battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/ab450f017cce903220f99c24f0f21193648fb4f8.png[/img]

⠀⠀⠀⠀Aglovan turned to his officers, his voice steady and commanding. "We make landfall within the hour. The enemy will be entrenched, and they will not expect us to strike so soon. That is our advantage. We must move quickly and with precision."

⠀⠀⠀⠀Captain, his trusted second-in-command, unfurled a map on the deck, the corners held down by the salt-stained fingers of seasoned warriors. "Our scouts report that the enemy’s main force is concentrated inland, near the heart of the Darkwoods. But the shores are patrolled by their vanguard, and they have erected fortifications here, here, and here," he pointed to three positions along the coast. "Our first task will be to break through these defenses and establish a foothold."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/f7e3f053447c15124290a8cb21e56ef3a058e560.png[/img]

⠀⠀⠀⠀Aglovan studied the map, his mind racing through the possibilities. "We need to hit them where they’re weakest. A two-pronged assault—one group will create a diversion at the southern fort, drawing their forces away. The second group, led by me, will strike the central fortification. Once we secure the beachhead, we’ll push inland and regroup for the main assault."

⠀⠀⠀⠀The officers nodded, their faces set with grim determination. Aglovan continued, "Remember, this is just the beginning. The enemy thinks they own these lands, but they do not know the fury we bring. We fight not just for Darkwoods, but for all of Mantaria. Every inch we reclaim is a step closer to freeing our world."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/0f3f7217286273edd23c2fb6f1adb285b9127ebc.png[/img]

⠀⠀⠀⠀He turned to address the gathered troops, their eyes shining with the same resolve that burned in his chest. "Prepare yourselves! The shores of Darkwoods await, and with them, the first victory in our campaign to liberate Mantaria. We will show them that the heart of this island still beats strong!"

⠀⠀⠀⠀As the ship drew closer to the shore, Aglovan's thoughts turned inward. This was his home, a land he had sworn to protect. The first battle was at hand, and the fate of Mantaria rested on their shoulders. But with courage, strategy, and unity, they would reclaim what was lost—and begin the long journey to restore peace to their world.

notes.title: LORE PIECES #1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/3a831a6779449325eac396697a2c1d656ec73df4.png[/img]
[h1]The Darkwoods Awakening[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/329c7fb8fbe38bdd4e2c6482539c0c9ec377391f.png[/img]

⠀⠀⠀⠀The island of Darkwoods was once a place of serene beauty, where ancient trees whispered tales of old and the air was filled with the songs of birds. But now, the landscape was marred by the scars of war. Fires blazed, casting ominous glows through the dense forest, and the once vibrant ecosystem lay in ruins. Aglovan, the Avatar of the first faction, stood on the deck of his ship, staring at the smoldering horizon with a heavy heart.

⠀⠀⠀⠀"Captain, how did it come to this?" Aglovan's voice trembled, betraying his sorrow. "Our home... turned to ash and shadow."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/d92fee6e71d9a816940e785ac38e46c0dd03a54b.png[/img]

⠀⠀⠀⠀Captain, a seasoned warrior and loyal friend, stood beside him. "Aglovan, we will restore Darkwoods. The enemy's presence is but a blight we shall cleanse."

⠀⠀⠀⠀Aglovan clenched his fists, his knuckles white with tension. Memories of his childhood, of running through these forests and listening to the wisdom of the elders, flooded his mind. "I remember the days when these woods were a sanctuary. Now, they are a battleground."

⠀⠀⠀⠀Captain placed a reassuring hand on Aglovan's shoulder. "This is our mission. We fight not just for the land but for the soul of Darkwoods. Your leadership will guide us to victory."

⠀⠀⠀⠀Taking a deep breath, Aglovan nodded. "You're right. This is no time for despair. The people of Mantaria depend on us. We must reclaim our world, for every tree, every creature, and every soul that calls this place home."

⠀⠀⠀⠀With renewed determination, Aglovan turned to address his soldiers. "Prepare for landing! We will fight with the fury of a thousand storms. Mantaria shall rise from the ashes, and we will be its liberators!"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/8ef4dca9b073c00c734cecd11f03c7bc1d3cfe86.png[/img]

⠀⠀⠀⠀As the ship approached the shore, Aglovan's heart steeled with resolve. The island world of Mantaria, his home, would be freed from the clutches of evil. And under his leadership, hope would once again flourish amid the ancient lands.

[h3]Gamescom 2024: A Remarkable Experience[/h3]

Our team had the incredible opportunity to attend Gamescom 2024 in Cologne, where we showcased Shields of Loyalty and connected with a vibrant community of developers, publishers, and gaming enthusiasts. The event was a massive success, allowing us to expand our network, gain valuable insights, and build partnerships that will propel the game to new heights. notes.notes:
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/333549967681e2933af61dd9b70abd7beba36fab.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/111fc006d4d8a26227a98a4617ae0b599add6c02.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Greetings, Commanders![/h3]

We’re thrilled to bring you another update as we continue to expand the world of Shields of Loyalty.

This time, we're taking you deeper into the heart of Mantaria with a first look at our latest map, which is currently a work in progress. Alongside this, we are introducing the Warlord Highlands, a rugged and strategic region where the Warlord Faction will establish their dominance.

[h3]New Map:[/h3]

A World in Progress

Our team has been hard at work designing a detailed and expansive new map that will challenge your tactical abilities like never before. While still in development, this map will offer diverse terrains and strategic points that will test your decision-making skills. Each region is being crafted to provide unique challenges and opportunities, making every playthrough a fresh experience.

Below you can find the first graphics for these awesome map designs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/06c44881f2ed2bea90e2caa4fbc765e74c86399f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/f35e9220278517f4fa34e963a8ffb9531d0b193d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/c9c9346091417a49d1df553c00fa22a0672953d0.jpg[/img]

[h3]The Warlord Highlands[/h3]

Located in one of the most treacherous parts of Mantaria, the Warlord Highlands will be the stronghold of the Warlord Faction. Here, you’ll find a variety of Warlord Faction buildings, each serving as a vital piece of their war machine. From towering fortresses to hidden camps, the Highlands are where the Warlords will gather their strength and prepare for battle. The design of this region reflects the raw power and relentless spirit of the Warlords, and it will serve as a key battleground in your journey to liberate Mantaria.

Here you can find these relentless lands in their awesomeness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/1e9258dca775fa8bb7eb8cb901ee2170f5013420.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Features[/h3]

In addition to the new map and the Warlord Highlands, we’re introducing some exciting new gameplay features. 

Now, flying units and land units can be positioned on the same hex, and you’ll have the ability to toggle between their controls easily. This adds a new layer of tactical depth, allowing for more complex strategies during combat.

We’re also making it easier for players to track their exploration progress. Ruins will now be clearly marked if they have been looted, so you’ll always know if an area has been fully explored or if there’s still treasure waiting to be discovered.

Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to refine the map and bring the Warlord Highlands to life. We’ve got plenty more features and content planned for future updates, which we’ll share with you soon.

Thank you for your continued support, and as always, keep your shields up!


The Shields of Loyalty Team

[h3]Extra Points of Interest (POIs)[/h3]

We're excited to share some of the new Points of Interest (POIs) that will enrich the world of Shields of Loyalty.

   [h3] Ruins and Remnants:[/h3] Explore abandoned fortifications and burned carts scattered across the battlefield, hinting at the epic battles that once took place.

Dive deeper into the world of Shields of Loyalty with these intriguing lore segments, which will explore the rich background of our game’s universe and provide fascinating insights into the heroes you’ve come to love. Each lore piece will uncover secrets, reveal hidden histories, and expand on the intricate world-building that makes Shields of Loyalty so unique.

Stay tuned for these captivating reads, and get ready to immerse yourself even further in the story behind your favorite game. We can’t wait for you to discover more about the heroes and the world they protect!

We're adding a variety of new Points of Interest (POIs) and decorative assets to enrich the game world and provide more strategic depth.

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/333549967681e2933af61dd9b70abd7beba36fab.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/111fc006d4d8a26227a98a4617ae0b599add6c02.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Hello, Loyal Shields Community![/h3]

We hope this message finds you well and as excited as we are about the latest developments in Shields of Loyalty. We have some thrilling news and updates to share with you today, focusing on the map editor, the ongoing work on animations and sprites, and a major announcement about our presence at Gamescom 2024.

[h1]Map Editor: Unleash Your Creativity[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/f5353ed3e71aa25cf32e2b6791fc935da3fee0b4.png[/img]

We are excited to introduce the upcoming Map Editor feature in Shields of Loyalty. This powerful tool will allow you to create and share your own scenarios, maps, and campaigns. Here's what you can look forward to:

[h3]Scenario Creation:[/h3]
Design intricate scenarios with custom objectives, events, and storylines. Tailor every aspect of the gameplay experience to your vision.

[h3]Custom Maps:[/h3]
Craft unique maps using a wide variety of terrain types, landmarks, and decorations. From dense forests to barren deserts, the choice is yours.

[h3]Shareable Content:[/h3]
Once your masterpiece is complete, share it with the community! Upload your creations for others to play and explore, and download scenarios and maps made by fellow players.

We believe this feature will significantly extend the replayability of Shields of Loyalty and foster a vibrant community of creators and strategists. Whether you're a budding game designer or a tactical genius, the Map Editor will offer endless possibilities.

[h1]Work in Progress: Animations, Sprites, and Polishing[/h1]
Our team is hard at work polishing every aspect of Shields of Loyalty to ensure a smooth and immersive experience. Here’s a peek into what we've been focusing on:

[h3]WIP Animations:[/h3]
We're refining character and unit animations to make every movement fluid and lifelike. This includes combat sequences, idle animations, and special abilities.

[h3]Sprites:[/h3]
Detailed sprite work is being enhanced to add depth and clarity to the game's visuals. We're paying close attention to character expressions, unit details, and environmental elements.

[h3]Polishing:[/h3]
Overall game polishing is in full swing. We're fine-tuning gameplay mechanics, balancing unit stats, and ensuring that every feature works seamlessly. Our goal is to deliver a game that not only looks fantastic but also plays beautifully.

Your feedback has been invaluable in this process, and we can't wait for you to see the improvements we've made.

[h1]Gamescom 2024: Meet Us in August![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/49b9cfdbfe6f510c50d16064cc5404410202bacf.png[/img]

We are thrilled to announce that Shields of Loyalty will have a stand at Gamescom 2024! This is a significant milestone for us, and we are eager to showcase our game to a broader audience. Here's what you can expect:

[h3]Exclusive Demos:[/h3]
Attendees will have the chance to play exclusive demos of Shields of Loyalty, featuring some of the latest updates and content.

[h3]Developer Insights:[/h3]
Meet the team behind the game! We'll be there to answer your questions, discuss development insights, and share our vision for the future of Shields of Loyalty.

[h3]Giveaways and Swag:[/h3]
We’ll have special giveaways and Shields of Loyalty-themed swag for our visitors. Don't miss out on the chance to grab some exclusive items!

Gamescom is one of the largest gaming conventions in the world, and we are honored to be a part of it. We hope to see many of you there and share the excitement of Shields of Loyalty in person.

[h1]Thank You![/h1]

As always, we want to extend our deepest gratitude for your support and enthusiasm. Your feedback and passion are what drive us to continually improve and expand Shields of Loyalty. Stay tuned for more updates, and keep those blades sharp!

The Shields of Loyalty Team

[h3]Hello, Loyal Shields Community![/h3]

Thank you for your patience and continued support as we prepare for our biggest updates yet. We're thrilled to unveil the latest additions to the Warlord Faction and some exciting new features for the Knight Faction. Let's dive into the details of DevBlog #13!

[h1]New Warlord Units: Elemental Forces[/h1]
The Warlord Faction is getting a powerful infusion of nature’s might with the introduction of Elemental Units:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/4022c79d74f26301c99602c19038f8f0b8f4ef97.png[/img]

[h3]Tier 1: Dryads[/h3]
Agile and elusive, Dryads harness the power of the forest to entangle and debilitate their foes. Their swift movements and natural camouflage make them formidable opponents in any terrain.

[h3]Tier 2: Sylphs[/h3]
Commanding the air and weather, Sylphs bring a tempest to the battlefield. Their ability to control the winds allows them to disrupt enemy formations and shield allies from harm.

[h3]Tier 3: Mother Nature[/h3]
The embodiment of nature’s wrath, Mother Nature wields the primal forces of earth, water, air, and fire. Her overwhelming presence can turn the tide of battle with devastating natural phenomena.

[h1]New Warlord Heroes[/h1]
Introducing legendary heroes to lead your Warlord armies:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/482f331d2edfa66ddb04ce1e12c4e12a0a5073d7.png[/img]

[h3]Mammoth Rider Xho[/h3]
Charging into battle atop a massive mammoth, Xho wields a colossal spear with unparalleled strength. His powerful attacks can break enemy lines and inspire fear in the hearts of foes.

[h3]Chief Manaskin[/h3]
A traditional warrior with unmatched prowess, Manaskin fights with dual axes. His ferocity and combat skills make him a relentless force, capable of taking on multiple enemies at once.

[h3]Skirmisher Vinur[/h3]
A master of close combat, Vinur’s expertise with the spear is unmatched. His agility and precision allow him to outmaneuver opponents and deliver critical strikes.

[h1]Knight Faction Bard's Camp[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/b21886b84fda3311fe7227d848a647efb8080694.png[/img]

We're excited to introduce the concept of the Bard’s Camp, a unique building for the Knight Faction where support units are trained. These bards will provide invaluable buffs to your army, enhancing their performance on the battlefield. Please note that this feature is heavily a work in progress and may undergo significant changes.

[h1]Coming Soon: Media Kit and Cinematic[/h1]

Stay tuned for next week, as we will be releasing a brand-new media kit along with an exciting cinematic trailer. Get ready for an immersive glimpse into the world of Shields of Loyalty.

Thank you for being a part of our journey. Your support and feedback are vital to us. Stay tuned for more updates and sneak peeks!

notes.title: Development Blog #12
notes.notes:
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/333549967681e2933af61dd9b70abd7beba36fab.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/111fc006d4d8a26227a98a4617ae0b599add6c02.png[/img][/url]

[h3]A Message from the Shields of Loyalty Team[/h3]

Greetings, Warlords and warmasters,

First and foremost, we want to extend a heartfelt thank you to our amazing community for your patience and unwavering support. Your enthusiasm and dedication fuel our creative drive, and we are incredibly grateful for your trust as we craft the world of Mantaria. As a token of our appreciation, we have a substantial update for you today, filled with new units, heroes, and a glimpse into our evolving environment designs.

[h1]Warlord Faction Units: Siege Units[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/d3b22d2a82b15d212bf1b2b3a2ef05aba7ffceb4.png[/img]
[i]Warlord Faction Siege Units are ready to demolish enemy formations and formidable castles to dust[/i]

[h3]Bone Ballistae (Tier 1)[/h3]
Introducing the Bone Ballistae, the backbone of your early siege arsenal. These fearsome machines, constructed from the remains of fallen foes, hurl massive bolts that can pierce through enemy defenses with ease. The Bone Ballistae’s devastating power lies in its ability to break enemy fortifications and create chaos from afar.

[h3]Stone Catapult (Tier 2)[/h3]
As you advance in your campaigns, the Stone Catapult becomes a pivotal part of your siege strategy. Built from ancient stone and reinforced with sturdy wood, this catapult launches enormous boulders that crush everything in their path. Its range and impact are unmatched, making it a critical asset during prolonged sieges.

[h3]Fire Sling (Tier 3)[/h3]
At the pinnacle of your siege capabilities stands the Fire Sling. This upgraded catapult not only launches heavy projectiles but also engulfs them in flames, turning each shot into a fiery missile that spreads destruction and panic among enemy ranks. The Fire Sling is the ultimate weapon for commanders who wish to dominate the battlefield with overwhelming firepower.

[h1]Warlord Faction Units: Spellcasters[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/df8347cfe0f58a374a17c196c69915a068633480.png[/img]
[i]As we are getting ready for the update of spell system, sneakpeeks like this will scramble the elemental balance of Mantaria, right? Right?[/i]

[h3]Earth Shaman (Tier 1)[/h3]
Harness the power of nature with the Earth Shaman. These spellcasters draw strength from the land itself, using their abilities to summon protective barriers and unleash seismic shocks against their enemies. The Earth Shaman is perfect for players looking to fortify their defenses and disrupt enemy formations.

[h3]Air Shaman (Tier 2)[/h3]
Taking to the skies, the Air Shaman commands the winds and storms. With their mastery over the elements, they can summon gusts to scatter foes and call down lightning to strike from afar. The Air Shaman adds a dynamic layer to your strategy, offering both offensive and defensive spells to control the battlefield.

[h3]Fire Shaman (Tier 3)[/h3]
At the height of their power, Fire Shamans wield the element of fire with unmatched ferocity. These spellcasters can incinerate enemy troops, summon walls of flame, and unleash devastating firestorms. The Fire Shaman is a force to be reckoned with, bringing unparalleled destruction to those who oppose the Warlord Faction.Warlord Faction Heroes

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/9f1c7373fba21564c230bf973e2145aa94a91b25.gif[/img]
[i]Some of our animations are ready to be used while our animation team is hard at work for the missing pieces.[/i]

[h1]Warlord Faction Heroes: Just a glimpse, more to come with the “first light of the fifth day”.[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/d4b78b623ded8e59359d697ab4d77b81ad2dbbba.png[/img]
[i]Stay tuned for awesome and heroic animations for these badass heroes.[/i]

[h3]Duke Gormur[/h3]
Once the formidable leader of the Warlord Faction, Duke Gormur now joins the ranks as a powerful hero. Though he has stepped down from his leadership role, his presence on the battlefield is nothing short of awe-inspiring. With enhanced attack animations and unmatched combat prowess, Duke Gormur is a hero who can turn the tide of any battle.

[h3]Ranger Sindri[/h3]
A master of stealth and precision, Ranger Sindri excels in reconnaissance and skirmish combat. Her keen eyes and quick reflexes allow her to strike enemies without them noticing, making her an invaluable asset in any skirmish. Sindri's expertise in guerrilla tactics ensures that your forces will always have the upper hand in ambushes and surprise attacks.

[h3]Captain Isungur[/h3]
Leading with valor and unwavering determination, Captain Isungur is the embodiment of martial discipline and strength. His presence boosts the morale of his troops and his tactical acumen on the battlefield is second to none. As a hero, Captain Isungur brings a blend of leadership and brute force that can rally your forces to victory even in the direst situations.

[h1]Knight Faction Siege Workshop Buildings[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/df295352232454f4d6d0b7b9e8ad98796e15f44f.png[/img]

[h3]Tier 1: Basic Workshop[/h3]
The Basic Workshop provides the foundation for your siege operations. Here, you can construct simple yet effective siege engines like the basic [b]catapult[/b], which can hurl stones to breach enemy walls and fortifications. This tier is perfect for early-game strategies, giving you the edge in initial skirmishes and castle sieges.

[h3]Tier 2: Advanced Workshop[/h3]
As you progress, the Advanced Workshop becomes available, offering more sophisticated siege machinery. With reinforced structures and improved technology, you can now build [b]trebuchets[/b] capable of launching heavy projectiles over greater distances. These powerful machines can devastate enemy defenses and create new tactical opportunities during prolonged engagements.

[h3]Tier 3: Master Siege Workshop[/h3]
At the pinnacle of your siege capabilities lies the Master Siege Workshop. This elite facility allows for the creation of the most formidable siege engines, including the devastating [b]cannon[/b]. Equipped with advanced mechanisms and enhanced firepower, these engines can shatter even the most fortified strongholds, ensuring your dominance in the late game.

[h1]Art Sketches and Environmental Decorations[/h1]

We are excited to share some preliminary art sketches for new environmental decorations and buildings. Our team is hard at work designing elements that will bring the world of Mantaria to life, from flapping flags and burning torches to intricate building animations. These sketches are a glimpse into the vibrant and immersive environment we are creating for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/3da61b530bc093f437bdf2e8fa0ac918bae0e72b.png[/img]

[h1]Stay Tuned for More[/h1]

Stay tuned for more updates and sneak peeks as we continue to develop and refine these features. Your feedback and support are invaluable to us, and we look forward to sharing more of our progress with you.

Don’t forget that most of these features are WIP (Work in Progress) so your feedbacks can still shape the future of Mantaria.

Until next time, may your weapons be sharp and enemies worthy of your strength.

Greetings, noble warriors and loyal denizens of Mantaria,

Welcome to DevLog#11! We're excited to share significant updates that will enhance your strategic experience in Shields of Loyalty. This week, we introduce our new Army Management UI, offer a sneak peek at Spellcaster units, and unveil the awe-inspiring Flying Units of the Warlord Faction. Let's dive into the details!

[h1]New Army Management UI[/h1]

We are thrilled to unveil our new Army Management UI, designed to streamline your strategic decisions and enhance ease of use. This revamped interface combines army management and upgrade screens into a single, intuitive hub. Now, managing your troops and fortifications will be more efficient than ever, 
allowing you to focus on leading your armies to victory.

[i]Check out the screenshot below for a preview of the new UI.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/c0e2f56bfaefe38a45a8839a0fbdad8f9d1e4d33.png[/img]
[i]New UI is combining both training and army management screens for ease of use and decreasing extra screens for these actions.[/i]

[h1]Spellcaster Units Sneak Peek[/h1]

Prepare to harness the arcane powers of Mantaria with our new Spellcaster units. These units bring a unique dynamic to the battlefield, offering powerful spells and support abilities to turn the tide of battle. 

[i]Take a look at the screenshot and GIF below for a glimpse of the spellcasters in action.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/486f0514d4379e2d4410969d7ce2caf0e91de2ec.png[/img]
[i]Spellcaster Cultist unit using her Grimace of Fear spell.[/i]

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/453cc26e20c36e0e164415e970e696f75cfa67fb.gif[/img]
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[i]Hand of God in action.[/i]

[h1]Warlord Faction Flying Units[/h1]

Take to the skies with the new Flying Units of the Warlord Faction. These units offer unparalleled mobility and unique combat advantages, allowing you to dominate the battlefield from above.

[h3]Battle Owls (Tier 1)[/h3] - Agile flyers equipped with keen vision and swift attacks for hit-and-run tactics.
[h3]Valkyries (Tier 2)[/h3] - Fearsome aerial warriors, combining aerial speed with devastating melee attacks.
[h3]Thunderbirds (Tier 3)[/h3] - Commanders of storms, wielding immense power and terror from the skies.

[i]Check out the picture and GIFs below to see these flying units in all their glory.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/73c7e344bd65f83c99b1a7eaeb442464030f539e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/81b991d3b4a695724ea0adcbd7a301fb6c603b94.gif[/img]

[h1]Stay Tuned for More[/h1]

This update is just a taste of what's to come. We are continuously working to enhance and expand Shields of Loyalty, and your feedback is crucial to this process. Share your thoughts on these new features and let us know what you'd like to see next.

Don’t forget that most of these features are WIP (Work in Progress) so your feedbacks can still shape the future of Mantaria.

Until next time, may your banners fly high and your victories be many.

Greetings, noble warriors and loyal denizens of Mantaria,

As we continue our march towards the grand launch of Shields of Loyalty, we are excited to present DevLog#10. This week, we shine a spotlight on the formidable new units of the Warlord Faction and the upgradable buildings of the Knight Faction. Get ready for an in-depth look at our latest additions, designed to enhance your strategic arsenal and fortify your strongholds.

[h1]Exciting Announcement: Shields of Loyalty on GOG![/h1]

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/3bf2430d90ac8c50d2619cb1701e509d93177fe0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/db65b5660995d002aa2a8eaca7ccc319453f50d5.png[/img][/url]

We are thrilled to announce that Shields of Loyalty will also be available on GOG (Good Old Games)! This means even more players can experience the epic battles and strategic depth of our game. Whether you prefer Steam or GOG, we've got you covered. Get ready to embark on your journey to save Mantaria on your favorite platform. Stay tuned for more details as we approach the release!

[h1]New Warlord Faction Units[/h1]

Prepare to expand your command with two new types of units, each bringing unique strengths and tactical advantages to the battlefield.

[h1]Ranged Units:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/433d5b49369e1244960fba4801a5c25def134230.png[/img]

[h3]Spear Throwers (Tier 1)[/h3] - Reliable and efficient, these units excel at medium-range attacks with their deadly spears.
[h3]Elven Bowmen (Tier 2)[/h3] - Highly skilled archers with precision and agility, capable of inflicting significant damage from a distance.
[h3]Pyromaniacs (Tier 3)[/h3] - Masters of fire, these units launch incendiary attacks that cause widespread damage and chaos among enemy ranks.

[h1]Skirmisher Units:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/9ab080d1f25b38898aa99d4063827dafa5c09205.png[/img]

[h3]Nomadic Spies (Tier 1)[/h3] - Stealthy and resourceful, these scouts gather crucial intelligence and disrupt enemy plans.
[h3]Fast Scouts (Tier 2)[/h3] - Quick and agile, these units excel at reconnaissance and swift strikes, outpacing their foes.
[h3]Nordic Rangers (Tier 3)[/h3] - Elite skirmishers with exceptional combat skills and survival tactics, dominating the battlefield with their versatility.

[h1]Upgradable Buildings: Knight Faction[/h1]

Fortify your kingdom with the new upgradable buildings of the Knight Faction, each offering significant advantages and improvements at higher tiers.

[h1]Archery Range[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/160861abc36da95d3286c71cf0a1fa924d1a9c19.png[/img]

[h3]Tier 1: Basic Archery Range[/h3] - Trains Longbowmen, providing essential ranged support.
[h3]Tier 2: Advanced Archery Range[/h3] - Upgrades to train Crossbowmen with enhanced accuracy and damage.
[h3]Tier 3: Master Archery Range[/h3] - Offers access to Mounted Shooters and provides additional training bonuses.

[h1]Skirmisher Guild[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/191defe5c74dc897a225c8563fa9696061d0ba28.png[/img]

[h3]Tier 1: Basic Tent Camp[/h3] - Houses Trackers, laying the foundation for special operations.
[h3]Tier 2: Upgraded Skirmisher Hut[/h3] - Evolves into a more sophisticated structure, enabling the training of Knightly Scouts.
[h3]Tier 3: Assassin’s Guild[/h3] - Transforms into a fortified guild, training the most skilled Rangers.

[h1]Stay Tuned for More[/h1]

While this update focuses on expanding your tactical options with new units and buildings, our upcoming DevLog will delve into the highly anticipated UI update. Expect a detailed breakdown of the new system designed to streamline your strategic management.

We are eager to hear your thoughts on these new additions. Your feedback is invaluable as we continue to refine and enhance Shields of Loyalty. Until next time, may your banners fly high and your victories be many.

Greetings, noble warriors and esteemed members of the Shields of Loyalty community,

As we continue our journey towards the launch of Shields of Loyalty, we are thrilled to present to you the latest developments straight from the heart of Mantaria. The forge of Mosaic Mask Studio has been ablaze, crafting new features, refining gameplay mechanics, and preparing to unveil more about Warlord faction that will shape the destiny of this realm.

[h1]Unit Upgrades Evolve into Building Upgrades[/h1]

In our relentless pursuit of innovation, we are revolutionizing the way players enhance their forces. No longer shall you solely upgrade individual units; instead, brace yourselves for a paradigm shift as we introduce Building Upgrades. By fortifying your structures, you will unlock the potential to recruit formidable Tier 2 and Tier 3 units. Embrace this strategic depth, for the fate of your armies lies within the walls of your citadels. Also these buildings will have small animations like waving flags or training soldiers to liven’ up the space.

[h1]Sneak Peek: Upgradable Buildings[/h1]

While we unveil a glimpse of the formidable Knight Faction buildings, know that there are other structures shrouded in mystery yet to be revealed. Stay vigilant, for the foundations of your empire shall soon be fortified with new edifices, each bearing its own significance on the citadel that we are going to construct together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/92c075b713fbf46dcd1c52bfb25cd9099affa2ff.png[/img]

[h1]Sneak Peek: Warlord Faction Heavy Infantry Units[/h1]

Behold, warlords, for the Warlord Faction marches forth with a new breed of warriors. Among them stand the Heavy Infantry, stalwart guardians with bulky and strong statures and wielding weapons forged in the fires of war. These mighty warriors shall strike fear into the hearts of your foes, standing as bulwarks against the tides of darkness that threaten Mantaria.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/e9cbf4a56830f1fb455977b440bede317c51162e.png[/img]

[h1]Animating the Clash of Steel[/h1]

Our skilled artisans have updated some of the animations of both old and upcoming units. Witness the beauty of animations and imagine them on the battlefield. From the swift attacks of agile Gryphons to the powerful stomps of Mountain Trolls, each movement exudes the essence of warfare. Can you spot the mystical units hidden within these animations, never before revealed to mortal eyes?

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/0d1b591898acaf1ceff91b82331912fb8edf750b.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/0d1b591898acaf1ceff91b82331912fb8edf750b.gif[/img][/url]

[h1]Embracing Feedback, Forging the Future[/h1]

As we embark on this odyssey of creation, we are ever mindful of the invaluable feedback and ideas shared by our devoted community. Your passion fuels our determination, and your insights shape the very fabric of Mantaria's destiny. Together, let us march forward, united in our quest for glory and honor.

[h1]In Closing[/h1]

With each passing day, Shields of Loyalty draws closer to its destined hour. Yet, let it be known that the journey is far from over. As we tread the path towards release, let your voices ring loud and clear, guiding us towards a realm where legends are forged and destinies entwined.
Warriors of Mantaria, the hour of reckoning approaches. Ready your blades, fortify your citadels, and stand firm in the face of adversity. For in the crucible of war, heroes are born and legends are made.
Until next we meet on the battlefield,

The Shields of Loyalty Team

notes.title: Development Blog #7
notes.notes:
[h1]A Message from the Shields of Loyalty Team[/h1]

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀We understand that we have been less visible recently, but rest assured, our goal is to launch our game with its vision intact. Our team is diligently working to enhance, expand, and fortify our gameplay options. This includes addressing bugs, refining the UI for the best player experience, and crafting a distinctive environment for our story and gameplay to align with our release date and roadmap objectives. As we approach the final stretch towards the release of Shields of Loyalty, we value your feedback and ideas greatly. Be prepared, as you will soon hear from us more frequently than ever before.

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀Warlords and warmaidens, hone your blades, ready your shields, and muster your troops, for the fate of Mantaria will soon rest on your shoulders.

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀Thank you for believing in us and for your continuous support. We had a vision, you believed in it, and we are committed to delivering on it.

Mosaic Mask Studio
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/333549967681e2933af61dd9b70abd7beba36fab.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/111fc006d4d8a26227a98a4617ae0b599add6c02.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/d17a88d26d3dbc7d79b84b7e3205599d042ead98.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/eb9bdd7501f1c6c68195a45bf8cda19dec88c02e.png[/img][/url]


[h1]Updates[/h1]

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀In the upcoming weeks, we will announce and share the new unit assets, animation GIFs, future ideas, and updates. We are looking forward to receiving your feedback and suggestions.

[h1]Leader Change[/h1]

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀First of all we would like to announce that Warlord faction leader Gormur is now a hero of the same faction (But because of his demotion we will be giving him an awesome attack animation so don't worry and also we keep the horns :D) . Instead of relying solely on human leaders, we embraced the idea that our world is rich in fantasy. Inspired by this notion, we introduced KARNOTH, the new Chieftain of the Warlords.

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/48c3a30e8276504596f340b4cbc514c3de3e11f6.png[/img]
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀Warlord Faction Old Avatar/Leader - GORMUR
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/2bba571919e01d44d66b41426e87160ad9e00b1b.jpg[/img]
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀Warlord Faction New Avatar/Leader - KARNOTH
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/7191069e43c78d6bc98f3b662a3cd22af26d035f.png[/img]
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀Karnoth in game look
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]Huge Units[/h1]

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀Now, with the addition of Karnoth, players will have the ability to command huge units. Karnoth, a formidable minotaur warlord, will occupy 4 hex spaces instead of 1 to emphasize its colossal size. However, keep in mind that such large units will draw significant attention, making it easier for the AI to strategically position enemy units against them. This will also make managing the placement of your own units more challenging.

[h1]Spell System[/h1]

notes.title: Patch 8.1.4
notes.notes:
[h1]Engine update[/h1]

One of the bigger, behind the scenes, changes we've made was to move the game over to a much more recent version of the Unity engine. This includes a jump not only in a lot of minor but also a major engine release.
The decision was made for multiple reasons like the support for the previously used version will end in a very few months and the IDE was very unstable on our development systems to a degree hindering actual development.

[h1]Improvements[/h1]

- optimized internal fog of war management and overall performance (further visual and performance improvements planned)
- improved image compression/filtering quality in various areas of the game
- impact zones for particle effects added to all units so effects should most of the time happen on the actual unit's surface
- improved overall flow/speed of animations/actions, panels
- reduced the size of savegames by about 90-95%
- artifacts of fallen unit's will be added back to the inventory after the level has been completed
- added a "fast animations" option increase the overall speed of animations/transitions for a faster general gameplay
- improved input/controls
  - map can now be dragged/scrolled using the middle mouse button and the arrow keys
  - holding shift increases the scrolling speed
- improved camera handling, zooming in/out tries to focus around the position at the mouse cursor so it doesn't move around randomly anymore

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]

- fixed some issues with localized texts not updating during language changes
- using special abilities (or even dismissing) of enemy units isn't possible anymore
- units can't move through a storm without any impact anymore

notes.title: Development Blog #5
notes.notes:
[h1]Warlords and Ladies![/h1]

[h2]New UI - Part 2[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/e7868d97a29dc3cb1248e05bbd81e39a743cda54.png[/img]
Now the UI will show all bufs, nerfs and features in the upper right section. By mouseover you'll see where the values come from. 

[h2]More details about the features[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/82a3b4f90fad99586f72540978f1812508c19366.jpg[/img]
Comes only 2 times per turn, if an Archer is adjacent to a friendly unit, which is currently performing an attack. The range limit of Archer is important. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/ca8a0d5cfb958908437c0050727d155737390853.jpg[/img]
Same as "offensive fire" but in defensive mode. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/da0e455c75bcb19caa9d900ec67ff448bb2d585a.jpg[/img]
Certain unit types (e.g. Nobleman Aglovan's heavy cavalry) absorbs a couple of damage from adjacent friendly units under attack.
Tier 1 heavy cav. = 10%
Tier 2 heavy cav. = 20%
Tier 3 heavy cav. = 25%

With each level of the unit, more damage will be absorbed:
Level 1 = 5%
Level 2 = 10%
Level 3 = 15%
Level 4 = 20%
Level 5 = 25%

So in total a tier 3 heavy cavalry at level5 can handle a maximum of 50% damage. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/c92375216ba909c7144911cedd4321aba4d987f1.jpg[/img]
All flying units perform an additional attack as soon as an adjacent friendly unit is under attack. 

[h3]Ambush[/h3]
If you uncover a hex that was previously in FOW and move directly in front of an enemy unit, this is considered as an Ambush. The previously moved unit cannot perform any further actions and the enemy unit performs an attack with increased damage (150%).

[h3]Surrender[/h3]
If an enemy unit is attacked and injured badly that it must retreat, but cannot because all adjacent hexes are blocked, it surrenders instead. Means that the unit is defeated and disintegrates. 

[h3]Training and Army Management [/h3]
We have tried to redesign the training screen to fit the new GUI both graphically and functionally. Basically, we succeeded in doing this, but we are still trying out another way. We want to integrate the training into the army management screen to eliminate the need to switch between them.

notes.title: Development Blog #3
notes.notes:
[h2]Balancing [/h2]
[olist]
[*]As part of the balancing, we have now also adjusted the calculation somewhat. While wounded were previously ignored in both defense and attack, they are now taken into account in defense. This makes the combat result more balanced and understandable.
[*] We have now also introduced a matrix that takes into account the Evasion and HitChance values depending on the hex you are standing on.
[*] In order to buff both the attack value and the defense value, the types of units will be taken into account more in the future. For example, if a heavy cavalry attacks a light infantry, the cavalry gets an attack bonus. Or if a heavy infantry attacks a heavy cavalry, the heavy infantry gets a defensive bonus.
[*] Offensive and Defensive Fire are now granted only 2 times per turn.
[*] Healing is now possible only 2 times per map per unit
[/olist]
	
[h2]Random Events[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Lightnings
They randomly strike on an area of one hex. Up to 4 lightnings can occur at the same time. However, they strike only in forests. With a certain probability the impact starts a fire, which spreads from turn to turn. Units suffer fire damage as soon as they are hit by the fire or lightning.
[*] Storms
They appear on open space with a size of 4 hexes and move away in a random direction for a random number of turns. Units caught by or drawn into the storm are immediately "blocked". Means they cannot move or fight for the current turn. 
[*] Ice Rain
These also occur on open space with a size of 4 squares and occur randomly. The ice rain causes medium area damage. 
[*] Ice storm
They work like storm but deal additional damage.
[*] Meteorites
These can strike any square. Up to 4 fields will be hit. Meteors cause high damage.
[/olist]

notes.title: Out Now! Version 0.8.0: The Eternal Ice
notes.notes:
[h1]Warlords & Ladies[/h1]

Finally, it is done! We know you've been waiting for it for a rather long while - and we'd like to take this opportunity to thank you for your patience - but now the wait is at an end: 

[h2]The Eternal Ice is here![/h2]

We already told you what you can expect in this version 0.8.0 "The Eternal Ice", but here you can see it again at a glance. Detailed patch notes will follow shortly.

One important info in advance:
[b]We changed the data structure for the maps. This means you will not be able to load save games of previous versions of this game.
This is the first and hopefully the last time this happen. Well, that's one of the downsides of early access...[b]

[h3]So, what’s new? Some new Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new world: The Eternal Ice
[*] Fire! Lightning can sometimes start a fire now!
[*] Added plateaus
[/list]

[h3]What else happened? There are some new Dynamic Level Events, for example:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Capturing locations can unlock new paths
[*] Certain units can be sworn in
[*] Graves can be searched for quest artifacts
[/list]

[h3]Oh, and of course there are Quality of Life Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Performance improved
[*] New animations added
[*] Reworked some UI elements
[*] Visual changes
[*] New music and sounds
[*] New visual effects
[*] Steam news can now be read ingame
[/list]

[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] We've made some improvements here and tweaked a few things!
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Several annoying insects smashed!
[/list]

[h3]The current version still contains the following known issues / bugs:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Various event texts are not displayed correctly
[*] Various event and animation sounds do not come or come at the wrong place
[*] Animations of the special abilities are partly not displayed correctly
[*] Information after events like lightnings are displayed with some time delay
[*] Balancing issues
[/list]

Another small hint: The ingame texts are currently only displayed in English and German, but don't worry: The translations will follow in a later patch. :)

We've created a thread in the forum specifically for your valuable feedback, so let us know what you think! 
We hope you like the version with its new content and features, preferably so much that you will let your friends know about it. 

Your team from Mosaic Mask Studio

notes.title: Version “0.8.0: The Eternal Ice” is coming!
notes.notes:
[h1]Warlords & Ladies[/h1]

It is with great pleasure that we can announce today: It is done! The new version "0.8.0: The Eternal Ice" will be released on February 25, 2022!
And it has it all!
[b][i]There is a brand new island, with 9 levels, in a landscape completely covered by snow and ice![/i][/b]

[b]What can you expect in this new version?[/b]
[list]
[*] New enemies
[*] A new, impressive landscape
[*] New events
[*] A completely new unit, the extraordinary Chariots, take the place of the Lizard Riders
[*] New hero units
The highly anticipated level 3 units from Aglovan and the AI
[/list]
By the way, the level 3 units come with their very own special abilities and thus bring even more strategic depth into the game!

[b]What else is new?[/b]
[list]
[*] We introduce another strategic element: Verticality! Yes, you read that right! Height differences will now play a more important role. Units on elevated positions will grant more bonuses.
[*] There are attack effects like blood splatters, feathers, dust or sparks
[*] The sea comes into motion: Animated water / sea and waves at cliffs
[*] And last but not least, the attack animations that have been eagerly awaited are coming!
[/list]

[b]That`s it? No, we have more:[/b]
[list]
[*] The army management has been completely reworked
[*] The main menu has also been reworked
[*] The buttons for the special abilities are now permanently visible in the menu rose
[*] More powerful disruption events with spreading fire
[*] There are brand new events that are triggered by certain actions
[/list]

[b]And then there are the POI:[/b]
We will be introducing many different types of POI as part of the "Eternal Ice" island, bringing a good mix of buffs and salvation.
You are curious? Here are two examples:
[list]
[*] Gates of the Old World: 2-4 hexes that are hidden in FOG can be made visible by the player.
[*] Stone Circle: All own dead units within 3 hexes are revived.
[/list]

So, save the date and we wish you a lot of fun ingame already!

Your team from Mosaic Mask Studio

notes.title: The Hype Is Real!

notes.title: Dev Blog #1
notes.notes:
[h1]Warlords,[/h1]

today's Dev Blog is all about the AI and tactics. 

We want to challenge you in each level and force you to develop a tactic to defeat the enemy. We stay fair! The AI sees what you see. No cheating, no artificial superiority!  
Of course this is not easy and the AI has to be fed with a lot of brainwax. It is our turn...

One of the important elements when it comes to tactics are the many features. Let's talk about the first 2 of them:

[h3]Ambush[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/bcddb07d9b0e36705a127c0a901d3ce0654af12e.gif[/img]
Be careful when discovering unexplored regions! If you encounter enemy units on your way to unknown regions, you will be ambushed and your journey will be stolen! 

[h3]Guardian[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748248/d9e663dce5aac9b1c5020f97a50390278c550af5.gif[/img]
Your flight units can escort any other friendly unit. If the escorted unit is attacked, the protecting flying unit will fight back too! 

More features will follow in the next dev blog.
